crowncrusher-riot.descripcion: A crew of anarchists rush to fight the dottari.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 21 to force them to back down, or Diplomacy DC 25 (expert) to request that they only injure the dottari
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The rioters lob bricks and other heavy objects at any dottari excruciator divisions as an action, dealing 2d6+10 bludgeoning damage to the dottari and any adjacent creatures (basic Reflex DC 27 save).

crushing-spirits-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-09: The Secluded Siege
crushing-spirits-7-8.descripcion: Spirits bound to sand-covered remains cascade down upon the living, imposing the weighty, helpless press of their final moments.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 21 or Occultism DC 21 (trained) to exorcise the spirits, or Diplomacy DC 25 to provide them with comfort. Each check requires 2 actions, which have the verbal trait, and three successful checks are required to address all ofthe spirits.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The haunt imposes the sensation of becoming buried beneath millions of grains of sand on all living creatures within the area. Each living creature must attempt a Will DC 24 save as the sensation threatens to overcome them. The creatures take 2d8+7 bludgeoning damage.

—

Critical Success The creature takes no damage and is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to all its Speeds for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes full damage and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to all its Speeds for 1 round. It also begins suffocating. The creature can begin breathing normally again if it leaves the area of the haunt or the haunt is disabled.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target takes double damage.

Effect: Crushing Spirits
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all living creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

dahak-s-skull.descripcion: A pair of magical gems inside the dragon skull's eye sockets act as magical sensors with a 30-foot radius.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (expert) two times to pry the gems embedded deep in the skull's eye sockets without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (4th rank, counteract DC 22) twice to dispel both eyes.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) On its initiative, Dahak's skull fires up to two eye beams; it must target a different creature with each attack. The eye beams can't target creatures directly below the skull.

dead-organ-5-6.descripcion: A magical pipe organ for controlling and bolstering the undead. Creatures that are trained in Performance can spend one action to attempt to play a tune.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (expert) to stopper the pipes. Each pipe stoppered imparts a stacking -1 circumstance penalty to Performance checks with the organ. Once four pipes have been stoppered, the organ ceases to function.

disgruntled-diners.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
disgruntled-diners.descripcion: Phantasmal diners begin hurling phantom food and very real, sharp cutlery in a dangerous food fight that targets intruders.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 25 (trained) to threaten the ghostly guests into submission or Religion DC 28 (expert) to exorcise the haunt; two successes are required to disable it.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On the haunt's initiative, the phantoms hurl ghostly food and real silverware through the room. All creatures other than Ilza who are in the area take 2d8+9 piercing damage (basic Reflex DC 24 save) from the sharp forks and knives being thrown about.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates at the start of any round in which Ilza is the only other creature present, then immediately resets.

dragon-pillar.descripcion: A 10-foot-tall wooden pole topped by a wooden carving of Dahak's head. Each dragon pillar's head has been treated with something to give it a distinct color, as indicated in the specific encounter, but regardless of color, plumes of smoke waft up from the mouth.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 26 (expert) to push the pillar over, or Thievery DC 26 (expert) on the pillar to erase the magic runes that power it, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 22) to dispel the pillar's magic.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its initiative, the dragon pillar fires an eye beam at the closest target within 120 feet.
datos.reinicio: The dragon pillar deactivates and resets as soon as it perceives no appropriate targets in range.

echoes-of-faith.fuente: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God
echoes-of-faith.descripcion: The restless spirits of clergy who once inhabited this now-defiled temple of Aroden remain within the sanctuary and pulpit.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 26 (expert) to exorcise the spirits, or Deception DC 28 or Religion DC 28 (trained) to imitate the Arodenite faith and render the haunt harmless until it resets
datos.reinicio: The spirits return in {1d8 hours} as long as any xulgaths remain in Moonstone Hall.

entangling-shredder-trap.descripcion: Dozens of ropes embedded with steel barbs spring out from the walls when at least two creatures step on the rugs.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 24 (expert) on the pressure plates.
datos.reinicio: manual

explosive-crystal-spheres.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
explosive-crystal-spheres.descripcion: Shimmering, glyph-graven, two-foot-diameter crystalline spheres shimmer and condense in the air, launching with explosive force at intruders.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (expert) to locate and deface tiny activation runes located at one of the six locations that spawn crystal spheres, or Arcana DC 28 (expert) or Occultism DC 28 (expert) to manipulate the magical energy at one of those locations to render the spheres inert, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract one of the crystal sphere spawn points
datos.rutina: (6 actions) On each of the trap's actions, a crystal sphere that hasn't yet taken an action during the turn either flies 25 feet toward the closest creature in the Outer Ring (if no creature is within 25 feet), or it attacks a visible creature within 25 feet (the crystal spheres can sense targets via darkvision). If a crystal sphere attacks a target, that target takes 1d6 force damage (basic Reflex DC 24) as the sphere hits them and bursts. A creature can be attacked by multiple spheres in a turn, but a sphere always targets the closest target. Once a sphere attacks and bursts, it vanishes but respawns at its spawn point at the start of the next turn and continues its routine. A sphere that has been destroyed or had its spawn point disabled vanishes and doesn't continue to respawn and attack, and the trap loses 1 action for each sphere destroyed or disabled in this way.

falling-portcullis.descripcion: A tripline under the arch causes the keep's portcullis to slam down, sealing the entrance and alerting the denizens of the keep to the intruder's presence.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (trained) to lock the portcullis

false-door-trap--pathfinder-179-cradle-o.descripcion: A black‑powder charge detonates as soon as the doorknob is turned, shattering the door into splinters.

datos.desactivar: {DC 27 Thievery} (expert) to disable the doorknob trigger

false-step-floor.descripcion: Each time a creature enters the room, it slips through the floor, tumbles through an interdimensional void, and falls back into the room through the ceiling, landing on the floor.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (trained) to disrupt the magical energy, or Arcana DC 27 or Occultism DC 27 (trained) to realign the magical energy
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 round.

fungus-covered-sinkhole.descripcion: A sheet of fungus covers a sinkhole that drops 30 down into area H7 below.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 19 to quickly cut a few key strands of fibrous fungus to cause the whole sheet to hang free

gremlin-horde.descripcion: Three gangs of gremlins hide within the spiral centurion, cackling with glee and hurling blasts of hex magic. The hazard occupies the same space as the spiral centurion, moving with it.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 25, Occultism DC 25, or Religion DC 25 (trained) to devise counter-hex symbols that frighten and scatter a gremlin gang, or Acrobatics DC 28 or Stealth DC 28 (expert) to capture and scatter a gremlin gang
datos.rutina:
(3 actions; misfortune) The gremlin horde hurls one tinkering curse with each action, targeting an item within 60 feet wielded or worn by a creature. The creature must attempt a Will DC 27 save. The gremlin horde loses 1 action for each gremlin gang that's scattered.

—

Critical Success The hex bounces back to affect the gremlin horde. For 1 round, all creatures gain a +1 status bonus to checks to disable this hazard.

Success The item is unaffected.

Failure The item becomes unreliable for 1 round. If a creature attempts to Activate the item or Interact with it, it must succeed at a Flat DC 5 or the action is wasted. If the item doesn't have an active use (such a mundane cloak), the creature wearing the item must instead immediately succeed at a Flat DC 5 or become tangled with the item and fall Prone.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature wielding or wearing the item also becomes Clumsy 2.
datos.reinicio: If not captured or killed, the scattered gremlin gangs regroup after {1d4 hours}.

hail-of-darts.fuente: Pathfinder One-Shot #4: Mark of the Mantis
hail-of-darts.descripcion: An array of spring-loaded, ceiling-mounted darts are primed to fire down into the hallway when triggered by a pressure plate.

datos.desactivar: Thievery (expert) on the floor tile or wall socket

haunted-aiudara.descripcion: The spiritual imprints of long-dead explorers haunt this aiudara, manifesting as a trio of astral wraiths who guard the gateway jealously.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 25 (trained) to exorcise one of the wraiths or Occultism DC 25 (expert) to erase one of the wraith's astral sigils; three successful checks are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina:
(3 actions; conjuration, divine, teleportation) With spectral claws, the aiudara wraiths hurl trespassers through time and space. Each of the three wraiths has 1 action which it can use to make a forceful hand Strike against a creature within 60 feet. The haunt loses 1 action for each successful check to disable the haunt.
When the haunt rolls a critical hit to Strike a creature, the creature is instantly shunted to an empty space within 30 feet. The haunt chooses which space the creature is transported to.
datos.reinicio: The aiudara wraiths disperse after 1 minute, but the haunt resets after 24 hours.

haunted-coop.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
haunted-coop.descripcion: A sudden flurry of shadowy pigeons erupts into a frenzy and breaks out of the coop.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 25 to recognize the unquiet animal spirits and soothe them, allowing the spirits to disperse
datos.reinicio: The haunted coop resets {1d4 rounds} after it's triggered.

heart-of-gloom.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-11: The Darkness Within
heart-of-gloom.descripcion: Within this mockery of a tree is a large, beating growth pushing grotesque branches through jagged planar fssures.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 25 or Occultism DC 25 to close of a planar breach, Athletics DC 21 to snap one of the branches, or 4th-rank Planar Tether to seal of a breach. For each branch snapped or breach sealed, remove one action from the Heart's routine. Once the Heart reaches 0 actions in its routine, it is disabled.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The Heart spends all of its actions making thorny vine Strikes against different creatures. The Heart doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.

hidden-forest-bog-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-99: Blessings of the Forest
hidden-forest-bog-5-6.descripcion: A 15-foot wide area of verdant-covered water attempts to suck creatures down into it.

datos.desactivar: Two Survival DC 25 (trained) checks to find roots and tree limbs sturdy enough for everyone to use as escape paths ends the hazard's threat to all creatures in the area
datos.rutina:
(one action) On its initiative, the bog pulls down each creature within it. A creature that was submerged to its waist becomes submerged to its neck, and a creature that was submerged up to its neck is pulled under and must hold its breath to avoid suffocation.

A creature partially or fully submerged in the bog can attempt a Athletics DC 23 check to Swim to either raise itself by one step (pulled under to submerged to its neck, or submerged to its neck to submerged to its waist), or to escape from the bog if it's submerged only up to its waist. This DC increases to Athletics DC 25 for creatures submerged up to their neck or worse. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down one step. Other creatures can Aid, typically by using a rope or similar assistance (providing an automatic success), or attempt to pull a single affected creature out with their own Athletics check, with the same results as if the aiding creature attempted the check itself.
datos.reinicio: The hazard still submerges anyone who walks in, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it accumulates leaf and greenery cover over the course of 24 hours.

history-s-repetition-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
history-s-repetition-5-6.descripcion: Pebbles form into a hand the size of an ox, which reaches to crush anyone in the water.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (trained) to pick apart the pebbles, or Warfare-lore DC 21 (trained) to recognize and recreate the battle
datos.reinicio: 24 hours

hostile-architecture-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
hostile-architecture-5-6.descripcion: The sigils on the door's frame glow with an amber light, which collects in a facet over the center of the door.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 19 (trained) to strategically destroy the runes, Thievery DC 21 to disrupt the beam from collecting the facet, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank, counteract DC 21) to dispel the rune
datos.rutina: a The hostile architecture fires its aversion beam on a creature that is sanctified holy. If there are no sanctified holy creatures, it instead fires its beam on the nearest non-demon creature.
datos.reinicio: The Hostile Architecture resets after being exposed to the light of a blue moon.

hungry-cottage.descripcion: Iron Taviah's cottage comes to life and tries to eat everyone in it. The hazard is divided into three areas: the basement becomes the cottage's stomach; the stairs act as the cottage's throat, becoming a steep, slippery incline that is greater difficult terrain; and the ground floor is the inside of the cottage's mouth. Creatures within the cottage can move around within it but can't exit without pulling the mouth open or slipping out while its teeth gnash. Characters who successfully escape the cottage are safe from the hazard.

datos.desactivar: The hungry cottage can't be damaged or disabled, but the danger in each area can be temporarily mitigated. In the stomach: Athletics DC 17 (trained) to Climb atop the hoarded belongings and avoid contact with the acidic walls or floor for 1 round, or Crafting DC 25 (expert) as a 2-action activity to concoct an alchemical antacid that neutralizes acid damage dealt by the stomach for {1d4 rounds}. In the throat: Athletics DC 23 (trained) to hold the throat open for one round, allowing all characters in the stairs to use a Reflex save result one degree of success greater than their roll to avoid being pushed into the stomach, or Nature DC 23 or Survival as a 2-action activity to ease the throat's contractions and provide the same effect for {1d4 rounds}. In the mouth: Athletics DC 22 to Force Open a window or a door and forcibly expel one creature that's within 10 feet of an exit from the cottage, or Athletics DC 25 (expert) as a 2-action activity to jam furniture in place that prevents the teeth from gnashing for {1d4 rounds} and allows anyone in the cottage to move from it during that time.
datos.rutina: The cursed cottage uses 3 actions: Acidic Assault in the stomach, Swallowing Staircase in the throat, and Gnashing Portal in the mouth (in that order). Checks to disable the areas might prevent these actions for a brief time.
datos.reinicio: Once no creatures remain in the cottage, the hazard resets and returns to a normal cottage. The stairs and the basement are gone, however, as is Iron Taviah's body.

kugaptee-s-anger.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
kugaptee-s-anger.descripcion: The sound of toppling trees and thunderous footsteps fills the air, as if some immense giant had taken notice and now slowly approaches through the forest.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 23 or Religion DC 23 to offer prayers against the evil to reduce Kugaptee's Anger's actions during its routine to 1 (see below) for 1 round; placing Sui-Jing's heart into her corpse at area A2 is the only way to disable this hazard
datos.rutina:
(2 actions) Darkness, fog and the sound of something immense striding just out of sight through the forest fills the air. The haunt's first action is to unleash a Terrifying Roar (Will DC 22 with the same effects as Terrifying Roar above). The second action is to infuse the trees of the entire mindscape with malevolent life, causing clawlike branches to lash out at each PC. These claws inflict 4d6 slashing damage (basic Reflex DC 22 save) to each character. A character standing on the path or in a clearing gets a +1 circumstance bonus to this saving throw, and the character who carries Sui-Jing's heart gains a +4 item bonus to this saving throw. On a PC's turn, they can take further action to protect themselves from the clawed branches. By Raising a Shield or by Dropping Prone, a PC gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their Reflex saving throw. A Prone PC can Take Cover to gain the benefits of greater cover against the claws (increasing their circumstance bonus to this Reflex save to +4). A PC who Tumbles Through on their turn and succeeds at a Acrobatics DC 22 check gains a +2 status bonus to their Reflex saves against the clawed branches. A PC who succeeds at a Stealth DC 22 check to Sneak improves the result of their Reflex save by one degree of success.
If a PC successfully used Nature or Religion to pray against the evil on the previous round, Kugaptee's Anger has only 1 action; randomly determine if it uses its Terrifying Roar or lashes out with trees with this action.

kugaptee-s-tree.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
kugaptee-s-tree.descripcion: The branches of the stone tree statue animate, extend, and lash out at intruders.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 25 to exorcise the haunt, or Intimidation DC 28 to appear overwhelmingly strong of body and mind so that the haunt recoils and fades
datos.rutina: (3 actions) Kugaptee's tree lashes out with its branches, using its actions to make three branch Strikes. Targets that are within reach but are outside of area E3 have cover from the surrounding archways. The haunt favors targets in area E3 but otherwise selects its targets randomly.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

mouth-of-tchekuth.descripcion: The chasm below shifts and ripples, transforming into a vast, gaping mouth filled with countless sharp fangs. A puckered, rasping tongue lances up from the noxious gulping depths below to lash and taste. Two words boom up from the vast throat below: "Iö Tchekuth!"

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 28 or Religion DC 28 (to exorcise the startling phantasm)
datos.reinicio: The haunt resets after 24 hours and is destroyed permanently if Ioseff's ghost is put to rest.

muesello-s-best-summoning-rune.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-11: No Time for Treason
muesello-s-best-summoning-rune.descripcion: A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 5-foot radius surrounds an invisible wall or floor rune the size of the creature to be summoned.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 23 to approach without triggering the trap followed by Thievery DC 25 (expert) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets each day at dawn.

murderous-bathhouse-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-13: Devil at the Crossroads
murderous-bathhouse-5-6.descripcion: Linneus's grudge manifests as a haunt that isolates creatures in the bathroom and attempts to psychically drown them in one of three containers of water: the sink, the bath, or the wash bucket.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 25 (expert) to exorcise the spirit from one of the containers of water, or Athletics DC 26 or Thievery DC 26 (trained) to overpower the ghostly force sealing a container and drain it. All three containers must be disabled to disable the entire haunt.
datos.rutina:
(one action) One creature within the room must attempt a Will DC 25 save as the haunt attempts to drown them.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure A ghostly version of the creature's face appears in the water of the sink, the bath, or the wash bucket. The creature immediately experiences the sensation of being underwater, and if it can't breathe water, it must begin to hold its breath to avoid suffocation. The haunt can affect only one creature per container remaining in the haunt. If the creature leaves the room, it's immediately freed.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature immediately loses 1d4 actions' worth of air.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates and resets after 1 minute.

mushroom-ring-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-00: The King in Thorns
mushroom-ring-5-6.descripcion: This mushroom ring forms a portal to the First World, allowing the Thorned Monarch's reinforcements into the Material Plane. When the PCs approach, a creature emerges. Creatures continue to emerge until the mushroom ring is disabled. Disabling the mushroom ring also causes any creatures that have emerged to disappear.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 21 (expert) or Nature DC 25 (trained) to rearrange the mushrooms to disrupt the portal (two actions) or Dispel Magic (3rd rank, counteract DC 23) to counteract the magical properties; three successes are required to disable the portal
datos.rutina: (1 action) A Korred emerges from the mushroom ring and defends it. All korreds use the mushroom ring's initiative.

mutated-brown-mold.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
mutated-brown-mold.descripcion: This unassuming fungus leeches heat out of the air.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 25 (trained) to safely remove the mold
datos.reinicio: After expanding, the brown mold can't grow again for 1 day.

nightmare-terrain.descripcion: What seems like an innocent stretch of land assaults trespassers with terrible illusions.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 22, Nature DC 22, Occultism DC 22, or Religion DC 22 (by a hero with expert proficiency in that skill) three times to temporarily disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank, DC 25)
datos.rutina:
(1 action) Terrible visions assail the minds of all creatures who can see within the affected area. Each creature must attempt a Will DC 24 saving throw.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 2.

Failure The creature takes 2d8+9 mental damage and is Frightened 3.

Critical Failure The creature takes 4d8+18 mental damage and is Frightened 4.
datos.reinicio: The terrible visions cease after all creatures have left the affected area, but the hazard is immediately ready to inflict its visions on the next creature to enter.

oozeshardling-node.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-07: A God Falls Where Magic Fails
oozeshardling-node.descripcion: A lump of bluish ooze shot through with what look like tiny silver shavings of metal. Once it has been activated, it glows with arcs of electricity that leap out at nearby targets.

datos.desactivar: Two successful Arcana DC 21 or Occultism DC 21 (trained) checks on the oozeshardling to disperse its power, or Acrobatics DC 23 or Thievery DC 23 (expert) to remove the flecks of empowering warshard from within the oozeshardling. A failed Acrobatics or Thievery check to disable an oozeshardling results in the creature attempting the check taking 1d6 acid damage (2d6 acid on a critical failure).
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The oozeshardling uses its first action to make an electric spark Strike against one random non-ooze creature within range, its second action is used to move straight in a random cardinal direction (roll  to determine the direction), and its third action to make a second electric spark Strike against a different random non-ooze creature within range. The oozeshardling doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.
datos.reinicio: The oozeshardling node collapses and melds back into the oozeshard after 1 minute, or disappears entirely if the oozeshard is slain.

paper-locust-tornado.descripcion: A book unfurls and its case forms into a leathery locust, its pages folding into an overwhelming swarm.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 to tear up the leather locust, or Arcana DC 21 (trained) or Dispel Magic (3nd rank; counteract DC 25) to render the magic inert.
datos.rutina:
(2 actions) The tornado uses each action to move up to 30 feet and share a creature's space, slicing into them with their paper wings and spurs. The targeted creatures must attempt a Reflex DC 24 save.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature takes 2d8+9 slashing damage.
Failure The creature takes 2d8 slashing damage and 1d10 persistent damage.
Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is Clumsy 1.
datos.reinicio: The paper locust tornado resets after 1 minute if there are no creatures to target.

phantasmagoric-fog-trap.descripcion: Cloying violet mist billows from the undergrowth, filling the heads of any creatures inside with maddening visions of dark moonless nights, twisted malignant trees, and steaming rivers of blood.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 28 (expert) to find a path through the Grand Hall that doesn't disturb the undergrowth

phantom-bells.descripcion: The echo of diabolic bells reverberates with a bone-shaking clamor.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 27 (expert) to break the curse with recitations against the power of Hell (2 actions), or Performance DC 22 (expert) to Perform an opposing composition
datos.rutina: (1 action) The bells toll, dealing 4d6 sonic damage to each living creature within 30 feet (basic Fortitude DC 24 save).
datos.reinicio: The bells cease ringing if there are no living creatures within 30 feet.

possessed-daeodons.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-15: Cleansing the Flame
possessed-daeodons.descripcion: Three daeodon corpses, animated and enraged by Sezelrian's divine intervention, trample anything within the ritual circle.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 21 or Religion DC 21 to disrupt the magic animating the spirits, Athletics DC 25 to hold down one of the daeodons, or Dispel Magic (3rd-rank, counteract DC 25). 3 successes are required.
datos.rutina: (three actions) The animated daeodons trample all creatures within the circle, dealing 2d8+9 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex DC 23 save).
datos.reinicio: The hazard resets within 24 hours if the cultists of Sezelrian still remain in the area.

rigged-cubby.descripcion: A hidden string connected to precariously stacked bricks causes the cubby to collapse in on itself when the string is pulled.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 20 to cut the string without setting off the trap

rolling-stone-cylinder-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm
rolling-stone-cylinder-trap.descripcion: A 10-foot-long, 5-foot-thick column of stone thuds to the ground, just in front of the bridge. It immediately starts to roll down the bridge, quickly picking up speed.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 check to create a wedge to immobilize the column, Athletics DC 21 check to immobilize the column until the end of the creature's next turn, a creature can Climb over an Immobilized column with a successful Athletics DC 18 check.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The rolling stone cylinder trap uses Crushing Roll.

rusty-grate-pit.descripcion: The rusty grate covers a pit that's 10 feet in diameter and 40 feet deep.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 to harmlessly trigger the trap by nudging the gate or the dangling winch, or Thievery DC 24 to stabilize the grate so it doesn't collapse.

season-s-toll-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-16: The Perennial Crown Part 1, Opal of Bhopan
season-s-toll-5-6.descripcion: Arcs of primal energy emerge from the L-shaped stone wall at the center of each alcove.

datos.desactivar:
Crafting DC 28 or Thievery DC 28 (expert) to rig up a dummy or other object to distract one of the trap's sensors, or Nature DC 26 (trained) to temporarily befuddle one of the sensors with knowledge of primal magic.

Alternatively, inserting the correct key into an alcove's keyhole disables that alcove's sensor.
datos.rutina:
(4 actions) The trap loses one action per magical sensor disabled. On its initiative, the trap uses each of its actions to target one creature adjacent to or within an alcove with a negative effect that corresponds to the season opposite the one depicted on the alcove's murals (Fortitude DC 27 to resist). For the purposes of this trap, creatures who are within an alcove's landscape count are within that alcove. The trap can target only one creature per alcove per round.

—

Spring Alcove (death) The decay of late autumn takes hold of the target.

• Critical Success The trap has no effect.

• Success The target takes 2d6+2 void damage.

• Failure The target takes 4d6+4 void damage.

• Critical Failure The target takes 4d6+4 void damage and 1d6 persistent damage. Effects that use vitality energy, such as the Heal spell, automatically end this persistent damage.

—

Summer Alcove (cold) Winter's bitter chill descends on the target.

• Critical Success The trap has no effect.

• Success The target takes 2d6+2 cold damage.

• Failure The target takes 4d6+4 cold damage.

• Critical Failure The target takes 4d6+4 cold damage and is Enfeebled 1 for 1 hour.

—

Autumn Alcove (poison) Poisonous springtime pollen sprays at the target.

• Critical Success The trap has no effect.

• Success The target takes 2d6+2 poison damage.

• Failure The target takes 4d6+4 poison damage.

• Critical Failure The target takes 4d6+4 poison damage and is Drained 1.

—

Winter Alcove (fire) Heat greater than the hottest summer afternoon engulfs the target.

• Critical Success The trap has no effect.

• Success The target takes 2d6+2 fire damage.

• Failure The target takes 4d6+4 fire damage.

• Critical Failure The target takes 4d6+4 fire damage and is Dazzled for 1 hour.
datos.reinicio: The trap is powered by the Eternal Bloom. It resets after 5 minutes, at which time the doors to the vault slam shut once again.

second-kiss-engine.descripcion: Exposed clockwork gears spin at high speeds.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) to disable the engine, or Engineering-lore DC 26 to disengage the drive shaft. Either method disables the trap but also shuts down the engine, disabling the Second Kiss's propulsion.

slashing-rune.descripcion: An invisible rune creates knives of force if someone tries to bypass the lock.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (trained) to silently erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the rune

soul-draining-cage.descripcion: Necromantic runes inscribed on the cage bars and lock drain the vitality of living creatures who interact with the cage.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (expert) to drain the runes' power harmlessly or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the rune

spitting-daffodil.descripcion: Daffodils spit acidic nectar at non-plant creatures in the area.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (expert) or Survival DC 25 (trained) to remove the plant's motion sensing filaments
datos.reinicio: The daffodils replenish their nectar and filaments after 24 hours.

storasta-s-last-stand-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-15: A Dirge for Sarkoris
storasta-s-last-stand-5-6.descripcion: A ghostly host of god callers and their eidolons manifests to defend the barrow against intruders, and the strains of a battle song fill the air.

datos.desactivar: Deception DC 25 to appear to be a defender of Storasta, Diplomacy DC 25 to demonstrate benign intentions, or Occultism DC 22 or Religion DC 22 to ward off the malevolent spiritual energies. Two successful checks are required to disable the haunt, and each attempt requires two actions.
datos.rutina: (1 action) (illusion, mental, occult) The haunt attacks what it believes is a demonic incursion, dealing 1d8+9 mental damage and 1d8 good damage to each living creature in the area (basic Will DC 24 save).
datos.reinicio: The haunt dissipates 1 minute after all living creatures leave area C1. Its spiritual energies re-form after 24 hours.

stranded-melody-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-16: Freedom for Wishes
stranded-melody-5-6.descripcion: Planar winds summoned from beyond sweep through the room, song and sound carried adrift on their current. This air elemental is trapped on the Material Plane and can't escape.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 24 (expert) twice to duplicate the melody and appease the elemental, or Arcana DC 27 (expert) and then Diplomacy DC 24 (trained) to guide the elemental through a planar tear elsewhere in the manor. Each attempt to Disable the hazard requires two actions, and each successful check to Disable removes one action from the hazard's routine.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) For each action in the routine, the melody makes a solid refrain Strike against one creature in its area. This trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.
datos.reinicio: The melody remains for 1 minute, after which it disperses into several holes in the walls. It returns after an hour unless disabled.

the-doom-of-azlant.descripcion: Fiery rocks from space crash through the skylight ceiling of the Azlanti throne room, showering those below in ceaseless cascades of fire and broken glass.

datos.desactivar: This is the end of days. The Doom of Azlant cannot be disabled or averted in any way.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) At the end of each round, starting on round 7, roll 1d8 to determine which section of the throne room of Azlant is struck by another Falling Star, rerolling results that indicate sections that have already been destroyed. The Falling Star destroys that section of the room, as well as any undestroyed pillars potentially containing veiled masters. Non-statted NPCs in that room section are killed instantly, consumed by otherworldly flame and crushed by flying debris. All PCs, palace guards, and vidileths not currently in a pillar who are in the room segment take 2d6+4 bludgeoning damage and 2d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 24 save). A critical failure also knocks the creature Prone.
Destroyed room sections function as difficult terrain, but also pose additional dangers. The first time during a character's turn that they take any action with the move trait that takes place wholly or partially in a destroyed room segment, roll 1d6 and consult the following additional dangers to see what that character must endure as a result of their movement.
1–2 Desperate Courtier Seemingly from out of nowhere, one of the servants or lesser nobles Fleeing in terror leaps upon the character, desperately clinging to their clothing and limbs and making movement more difficult. The character can avoid the courtier with a successful Reflex DC 24 save, otherwise the character takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to their Speed until they can  from the desperate courtier's clutches. Vidileths ignore this result, as no courtier is desperate enough to cling to one of these monsters!
3–4 Hail of Meteorites A bright red barrage of scalding space debris pummels the character for 1d6+4 bludgeoning damage and 1d6 fire damage, with additional effects determined by a Reflex DC 24 save.

—
Critical Success The creature takes no damage.
Success The creature takes half damage.
Failure The creature takes full damage and is knocked Prone.
Critical Failure The creature takes full damage, is knocked prone, and takes an additional 2d6 persistent damage.
5–6 Shearing Glass A razor-sharp sheet of jagged green glass tumbles down from the ceiling and threatens to bisect the victim. The creature takes 2d6 slashing damage, with additional effects determined by a Reflex DC 24 save. If the slashing damage from the glass reduces a creature to 0 HP, a pane of glass shears straight through the victim's neck, slicing off their head and killing them instantly.

—
Critical Success The creature takes no damage.
Success The creature takes half damage.
Failure The creature takes full damage and 1d6 persistent damage.
Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and 2d6 persistent damage.

the-enmity-cycle.descripcion: Discordant music, dance, and poetry combine to build a deep suspicion and distrust of strangers.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 26 to counteract the performance or Religion DC 27 or Occultism DC 27 to disrupt the spiritual energy. Three total successes are needed to disable the trap.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The performance continues to sow seeds of enmity, discord, and distrust on those in its area. All creatures in attendance other than Zridi must attempt a Will DC 25 save.

—
Critical Success The target is unaffected and is immune to the effects for 1 day.
Success The target is Frightened 1 for 2 rounds.
Failure The target is Frightened 2 for 1 minute and is certain the source of this fear is their fellow citizens, especially those from places other than their hometown. For 1 week the target suffers a –2 penalty to all Diplomacy skill checks against people from other Thuvian cities and regains the frightened 2 condition whenever they are in one of those cities.
Critical Failure As failure, but the target becomes a carrier for The Enmity Cycle for the next week. The target is compelled to travel to a city other than where they were exposed and recite as many lines from the anbarit as they can recall. Those who hear or witness the performance are treated as if they had attended a performance of The Enmity Cycle, but with a Will DC 23 save
datos.reinicio: A new production of The Enmity Cycle must be arranged; this process usually takes at least 1 week.

the-last-crucible.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
the-last-crucible.descripcion: Magically hardened sheets of obsidian drop down over the room's exits while the machinery within taps into wells of magma to begin spewing lava-and monsters-into the maze.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) to disable the main pressure plate at area H4a and deactivate the trap entirely (this causes the obsidian walls to retract up into the ceiling as well), Thievery DC 25 (trained) to disable one of the three lava spouts, or Athletics DC 28 (trained) to  a fallen obsidian wall
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The trap loses 1 action per disabled spout each turn. On each action, a different spout located at one of the three areas marked H4c spews a gout of lava at the closest non-thoqqua target in its line of sight; these spouts use magical sensors that have darkvision and a Perception DC of 25. Originally, agents of the abbot would come through here after the trap was triggered, deactivate it, and clean out the hardened blobs of lava and dead bodies that remained, but the amount of time it would take for this trap to clog tunnels with cooled lava makes tracking that slow accretion over the course of this adventure unnecessary.
datos.reinicio: The Last Crucible deactivates and resets 10 minutes after it has no target creatures (because the creatures either left area H4 or died). Any thoqquas that still live sense the magma river at area H6 and eventually make their way north to that area to swim away.

thin-wisps-fireworks-show.descripcion: Fashionable performers and revolutionaries rappel from the surrounding buildings on scarves.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 21 to turn away from the explosions, or Crafting DC 25 to identify the exact moment the fireworks will explode
datos.rutina: (1 action; visual) The Thin Wisps continue to launch fireworks until the dottari excruciator divisions are defeated. Each round, all creatures must succeed at a Fortitude DC 24 save or be Dazzled and Deafened for 1 round (or Blinded and deafened for 1 round on a critical failure).

toxic-furnace.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
toxic-furnace.descripcion: The smoking furnace begins to hiss and click, and its vents swivel and adjust to spew toxic fumes in the direction of intruders.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (trained) to render one of the vents useless, or Athletics DC 25 to wrench and bend a vent until it no longer functions
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The trap loses 1 action for each disabled vent. On each of the trap's actions, a vent spews a gout of boiling toxin at a living creature in sight of it. It can't target a single creature more than once per round, so if there aren't enough viable targets for all 3 actions, the trap loses those unspent actions.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 minute, during which it sees no creatures to target.

unholy-hunger.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
unholy-hunger.descripcion: An unspeakable miasma of foul-smelling vapor with shrieking faces barely visible in the steam bubbles up from the soup.

datos.desactivar: Cooking-lore DC 19 to neutralize the haunted soup with the addition of a few select spices from nearby shelves, or Religion DC 25 to exorcise the haunt
datos.reinicio: The haunt resets 1 round after the lid is replaced on the cooking pot.

urxehl-s-firestorm-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-22: Breaking the Storm: Excising Ruination
urxehl-s-firestorm-7-8.descripcion: Abyssal fire rains from the sky.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 28, Nature DC 28, Occultism DC 28, or Religion DC 28 (trained) twice or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 22) to cause a temporary, local disruption to the Disciple of Urxehl's ritual. Checks to disrupt the firestorm require two actions. Defeating the Disciple of Urxehl also disables the hazard.
datos.reinicio: The hazard activates when the PCs reach Event: Rain of Fire, area A1, and area A9. If the PCs defeat the Disciple of Urxehl, the hazard is permanently destroyed.

urxehl-s-firestorm-9-10.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-22: Breaking the Storm: Excising Ruination
urxehl-s-firestorm-9-10.descripcion: Abyssal fire rains from the sky.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 31, Nature DC 31, Occultism DC 31, or Religion DC 31 (trained) twice or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 24) to cause a temporary, local disruption to the Disciple of Urxehl's ritual. Checks to disrupt the firestorm require two actions. Defeating the Disciple of Urxehl also disables the hazard.
datos.reinicio: The hazard activates when the PCs reach Event: Rain of Fire, area A1, and area A9. If the PCs defeat the Disciple of Urxehl, the hazard is permanently destroyed.

violent-crowd.descripcion: Concerned citizens shout slogans about the dangers of dealing with Cheliax and throw bricks at Chelaxian sympathizers.

datos.desactivar: Succeed at two of the following checks in any combination: Athletics DC 25 (trained) to confiscate dangerous debris, Diplomacy DC 25 (trained) to calm the crowd, Intimidation DC 23 (untrained) to scare the crowd away, Will DC 28 (trained) to maintain a brave and confident demeanor; an effect such as Calm that can target an area counts as one automatic success.
datos.rutina: (three actions) The unruly crowd uses an action to chant a Catchy Slogan if it is not already benefiting from the effect It uses Shake Confidence once per turn and uses its remaining actions for cobblestone Strikes.

void-boils.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-17: Dreams of a Dustbound Isle
void-boils.descripcion: Tumor-like growths erupt from the isle as it responds to psychic attack, spewing black lightning and fire in every direction.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 26 (trained) to reshape the substance of the dream, or Performance DC 30 (trained) or Religion DC 28 (trained) to invoke Desna's blessing through hymns or prayers. Each check to disable the hazard is a two-action activity; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On the hazard's initiative, a boil erupts from the ground and bursts. This blast strikes as many enemies as possible in a 15-foot burst anywhere on the isle, dealing 4d8 force damage (basic Reflex DC 24 or basic Will DC 24, target's choice) to enemies in the area. Aslynn avoids targeting the nightmares with the blast.

what-all-heroes-fear.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
what-all-heroes-fear.descripcion: The depictions of heroic deeds transform as the lights dim, becoming testaments to cowardice and failure.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 25 to push back against the haunt with your own memories of bravery or Religion DC 28 to exorcise the haunt; three successes are required to disable it.
datos.rutina:
(2 actions; emotion, fear, mental) On its initiative, the haunt's first action is to randomly select one humanoid in the room. All of the depictions of Eragayl in the artwork transform to depict that humanoid, who becomes the focus of the haunt. On its second action, the haunt's depictions animate, showing the targeted humanoid as they are slowly destroyed by what they fear most. All humanoids in the room must make a Will DC 24 save, with the target taking a –2 status penalty to the save.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature takes 2d6+1 mental damage from the conviction that they'll be remembered as a coward and a failure.
Failure As success, but 4d6+2 mental damage, and the creature increases its frightened condition value by 1 to a maximum of Frightened 4.
Critical Failure As failure, but 8d6+4 mental damage. If the creature is already frightened 4, they become Paralyzed with fear until the start of the haunt's next turn.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates at the start of any round in which there are no living humanoids in the room, then resets 1 minute later.

xarwin-portraits.descripcion: The paintings suddenly start to bleed-Ioseff Xarwin from the left wrist and the other three Xarwins in a line cutting across their brows-as the viewers receive glimpses of the traumas the family endured.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 25 to exorcise one of the paintings (a critical success exorcises all of the paintings at once) or Thievery DC 21 to quickly cover a painting with a cloak or remove it and turn it to face the wall
datos.rutina:
(4 actions) The haunt uses up to 4 actions to afflict bleeding wounds on different creatures in area B22. These bloody wounds manifest where the target would have felt pain from Inflict Agony, regardless of whether they succeeded in resisting that effect or not. A creature can't be targeted more than once by this routine. Each creature affected must attempt a Fortitude DC 24 save.

The haunt loses 1 action for each painting that's disabled or destroyed.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 1d8+3 slashing damage and is Frightened 1 by the conviction that these wounds were caused by a loved one.

Failure As success, but 2d8+6 slashing damage, 1d6 bleed, and Frightened 2.

Critical Failure As failure, but 4d8+12 slashing damage, 2d6 bleed, and Frightened 3. Increase the value of the character's malevolence condition by 1.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour; putting Xarwin's ghost to rest destroys this haunt forever.

abendego-s-squall-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
abendego-s-squall-5-6.descripcion: Abendego's Squall leaps from the water. Its mouth opens to snap against any part of the ship that it can reach.

datos.desactivar: Medicine DC 23 (expert) to remove the harpoon, Nature DC 25 (trained) to calm the orca, or Intimidation DC 27 (expert) to scare the orca away; two total successes are required to subdue the orca
datos.rutina:
d Abendego's Squall thrashes against the hull of the Snapdragon. With each action, it makes a flipper Strike against a PC adjacent to the railing. Whenever it makes a flipper Strike, it also deals its Strike damage to the ship whether or not the Strike was successful.

—
Speed 30 feet

abyssal-firestorm-surge-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-24: Breaking The Storm: Parting Clouds
abyssal-firestorm-surge-7-8.descripcion: High winds and forest fires intensified by Abyssal energy batters everything in the surge's path.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 27, Nature DC 27, Occultism DC 27, or Religion DC 27 (trained) to redirect the storm surge or Dispel Magic (4th rank, counteract DC 23) to nullify it.

agonizing-thorns.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
agonizing-thorns.descripcion: A massive tangle of brambles weaves through a skeleton clad in armor.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 27 to delicately unthread the vines from the skeleton without triggering them; four successes are required to disable the haunt.

allegro.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
allegro.descripcion: A flock of animated paper birds flit about to the playful sounds of an Invisible flute, played by the invisible janni Mehryar

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 26 (trained) to create beautiful flying objects to complement the paper birds; Acrobatics DC 28 or Performance DC 25 (Performance DC 21 if using a flute) (trained) to perform along with the flute and paper birds (requires two successes); or one successful attack roll against the Invisible Mehryar (AC 25, Perception DC 25 to determine Mehryar's location)
datos.rutina: (3 actions) On each of the trap's actions, the flock of paper birds attacks a different creature. On a successful hit, each target must attempt a Reflex DC 26 save. On a failure, they take 2d6 persistent damage.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets if no hostile creatures remain outside.

angazhan-s-rake-trap.descripcion: Six metal talons concealed in the walls swing out and rake across the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (expert) to disable each talon
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 minute.

boulder-deadfall-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind
boulder-deadfall-trap.descripcion: A weight-sensitive plate buried underneath sand pulls a boulder over a cliff ledge, causing it to fall on targets within the entrance.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 27 (expert) or Thievery DC 25 (expert) to find and disconnect the plate from the tipping mechanism
datos.reinicio: Resetting the boulders in the trap is a labor-intensive project that takes 2 hours.

calcite-flow.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-13: Thick as Thieves
calcite-flow.descripcion: A seep of mineral-rich water coats any unattended objects in a layer of calcite.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 23 (trained) to shatter the calcite using the resonant powers of the consonite crystals plus Athletics DC 23, Nature DC 23, or Survival DC 23 (trained) to dam the flow of water.

chernasardo-chomper.descripcion: These animal snares have been repurposed to discourage unwanted intruders. When a creature steps onto the snare, jaws with sharpened teeth close around the creature's leg.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 26 (trained) to step clear the snare before it springs, or Thievery DC 22 (trained) to trigger the trap harmlessly

cleansing-cascade.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-14: The Tomb Between Worlds
cleansing-cascade.descripcion: The ritual power in this room, corrupted by necromantic energy, slams purifying water into all "unclean" creatures that try to leave.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 25 (expert) to ceremonially purify everyone in the room, by pouring water from a tub over their hands, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract the corrupted ritual magic.
datos.reinicio: 1 minute

clockwork-dancers.descripcion: Several clockwork humanoid figures armed with spinning blades move throughout the area.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (expert) to deactivate the clockworks from the control panel. Two successes are needed to deactivate the trap.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The clockwork dancers target each creature on the stage within 10 feet of a pillar by a spinning blade Strike.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates after 4 rounds and resets after 1 minute.

consonite-clusters.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-13: Thick as Thieves
consonite-clusters.descripcion: Consonite forms needle-like stalactites that can easily break free if touched, setting off a chain reaction that threatens to pierce anyone who stands in the area.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 23 (trained) to Squeeze through the caps between the needles.

darkened-shadow-bombard.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-17: Trapping the Hag's Claw
darkened-shadow-bombard.descripcion: A cannon built of cast iron and infused with shadow magic, mounted on the side of Aslynn's flying ship.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 28 or Thievery DC 28 to disrupt the cannon; two checks are required to disable it
datos.rutina: (three actions) The cannon fires a blast that contains as many PCs as possible, choosing randomly in the event of a tie, then reloads.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (master) to painstakingly remove the rune without triggering the magic, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract the rune.

drandlesticks-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-22: Breaking the Storm: Excising Ruination
drandlesticks-7-8.descripcion: Enchanted caltrops blend in with the surrounding masonry.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 to safely clear the path.

electrified-entrance.descripcion: Magical runes electrocute anyone who crosses the door's threshold.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 26 (trained) to jump through the door before the runes trigger, Thievery DC 28 (expert) to scratch out the runes, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the runes
datos.reinicio: 1 minute

empowered-oozeshardling-node.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-07: A God Falls Where Magic Fails
empowered-oozeshardling-node.descripcion: A lump of bluish ooze shot through with what look like tiny silver shavings of metal. Once it has been activated, it glows with arcs of electricity that leap out at nearby targets.

datos.desactivar: Two successful Arcana DC 22 or Occultism DC 22 (trained) checks on the oozeshardling to disperse its power, or Acrobatics DC 24 or Thievery DC 24 (expert) to remove the flecks of empowering warshard from within the oozeshardling. A failed Acrobatics or Thievery check to disable an oozeshardling results in the creature attempting the check taking 1d6 acid damage (2d6 acid on a critical failure).
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The oozeshardling uses its first action to make an electric spark Strike against one random non-ooze creature within range, its second action is used to move straight in a random cardinal direction (roll  to determine the direction), and its third action to make a second electric spark Strike against a different random non-ooze creature within range. The oozeshardling doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.
datos.reinicio: The oozeshardling node collapses and melds back into the oozeshard after 1 minute, or disappears entirely if the oozeshard is slain.

eternal-hall-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
eternal-hall-7-8.descripcion: Time distorts along this hallway, making the air feel like sludge.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (trained) to disrupt the temporal distortions, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to disperse the temporal energy

explosive-manifestation.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
explosive-manifestation.descripcion: Reality suddenly and violently transforms, shifting from a harmless patch of terrain into something truly deadly as the mindscape draws from memories of pain and agony, revisiting old wounds.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 27 to cause the hazard to fade away without triggering it, or Survival DC 30 to sense what parts of reality are in flux and to avoid the area

explosive-steam-trap.descripcion: A black‑powder charge fastened to a trapdoor (marked with a "T" on the map) blows a hole in a steam tunnel, filling the room with superheated steam.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 18 (trained) to disarm the desk switch; Thievery DC 28 (expert) to disarm the trapdoor charge
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The trapdoor emits a jet of superheated steam. Each creature in the room must attempt a Fortitude DC 28 save.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 1d10+3 fire damage.

Failure The creature takes 2d10+6 fire damage and is Blinded for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes 2d10+6 fire damage, is Fatigued, and is blinded for 1 round.

extremely-haunted-hollows.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-99: Under the Eye of the Mantis
extremely-haunted-hollows.descripcion: The spirits of innumerable dryads and peaceful wood elementals, ripped from their bodies as they were turned into furniture, writhe and seethe, lashing out at both living and undead alike.

datos.desactivar:
Diplomacy DC 23 (trained), Nature DC 23 (trained), or Religion DC 23 (trained) to set the spirits to rest or Deception DC 27, Intimidation DC 27, or Occultism DC 27 to convince the spirits that their eternal rest is coming soon.
A PC may make a Strike against AC 22 to destroy a single table or chair in the room, this functions as a successful check to Aid another PC attempting to disable the haunt; two total successes are required to disable the haunt. If all of the tables and chairs are destroyed, the haunt is temporarily disabled until dawn of the next day.
datos.rutina: (two actions) The Haunted Hollows haunt uses table flip or chair toss Strikes at different creatures in the area, favoring those who are trying to disable the haunt first, but otherwise choosing randomly. The table flip Strikes originate with any table in the room, destroying the table in the process. The chair toss Strikes originate with any chair or bar stool in the room, destroying that object in the process. If the haunt is not disabled, these objects reform and return to their original positions at dawn of the next day.

falling-portcullis-trap.descripcion: An iron portcullis drops from the ceiling when a pressure plate is triggered.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (expert) to disable the floor trigger, or Athletics DC 27 or Engineering-lore DC 27 to jam the portcullis in the ceiling

false-victory.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
false-victory.descripcion: After a battle concludes, the battlefield shimmers strangely as dead bodies twitch, destroyed objects shake, and feelings of déjà vu grow overwhelmingly strong.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 27 to cause the hazard to fade away before it manifests, or Deception DC 30 to pretend to ignore the growing continuity break and proceed without fear, causing it to collapse in on itself.

fiendripping-blast-trap.descripcion: A blast of energy damages all creatures within 20 feet, with particularly severe damage to fiends.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (expert) to identify the proper sequence of buttons in the divots, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to suppress the magical effect for 1 hour
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 hour.

flensing-trap-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
flensing-trap-7-8.descripcion: Rotating blades extend from the walls, floors, and ceiling of the surrounding halls when weight is removed from the trapped floor tile.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (expert) to disable the pressure plate
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 15 minutes.

frenzied-sea-life.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-03: A Foot in the Door
frenzied-sea-life.descripcion: A swarm of aggressive cuttlefish, octopuses, devil rays, and countless other species of sea life bite and bludgeon Timonithaea's enemies.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (trained) to remove the crown from the altar while avoiding being bitten by the swarming sea life, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 27) to disable the crown's enchantment, breaking Timonithaea's control over the sea creatures.
datos.rutina: (one action) The sea creatures attack, dealing 1d10+4 bludgeoning,1d10+4 piercing damage to each creature hostile to Timonithaea within the temple (basic Reflex DC 25 save).

greater-fireball-rune.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-09: Killer in the Golden Mask
greater-fireball-rune.descripcion: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 20-foot radius.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (expert) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the rune

helpful-wisp-swarm.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-13: Thick as Thieves
helpful-wisp-swarm.descripcion: Hovering amid the branches of an acacia tree, a swarm of wood wisps attempt to gather the papers that have been caught in its leaves and thorns.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy Diplomacy DC 21 (trained) to make a Request, Athletics DC 21 (trained) to climb the tree and help gather papers manually, or Performance DC 23 (trained) to demonstrate how the wisps can help without destroying the papers.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The wisp swarm loses one action for each successful check to disable it. The wisps swarm to work on each of their actions, making a headbutt Strike against any creature within 10 feet of the tree and destroying 2d4 pages of notes.

in-the-witch-s-grasp.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-11: Prisoners of the Electric Castle
in-the-witch-s-grasp.descripcion: Spectral hag claws reach out from the walls of the gem-like chamber to grab the PCs' souls and pull them into the trap's onyx facets.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 25 (expert) or Crafting DC 25(expert) to find the weak spot and crack each facet, or dispel magic (4th level; counteract DC 23) to counteract each facet; the hazard has a number of facets equal to the number of PCs.
datos.rutina:
The hazard gains a number of actions equal to the number of PCs; it loses 1 action each round for each facet that has been disabled. Each claw tears at a different PC, who takes 2d10+9 mental damage (basic Will DC 27 save). On a failure, they are Grabbed by the claw (). On a critical failure, or on a failure if they are already grabbed, they have their soul ripped from their body, which falls Unconscious. Each round on their turn, the soul can attempt a Intimidation DC 25, Occultism DC 25, or Survival DC 25 check to fortify itself and return to its body as a three-action activity. The possible outcomes are as follows.

—

Critical Success The soul returns to their body, which loses the unconscious condition.

Success The soul returns to their body, which loses the unconscious condition, but gains the grabbed condition.

Failure The soul makes no progress toward escape.

Critical Failure The soul makes no progress toward escape and the target takes 2d10+9 mental damage until they are reduced to 0 Hit Points, after which they remain in captivity until the trap is defeated.

—

Each claw focuses on its target until the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points, after which it takes no action on its turn unless another facet is disabled or its target regains Hit Points.

insolent-s-retort.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-14: The Tomb Between Worlds
insolent-s-retort.descripcion: Pressure plates trigger hidden mauls in the walls of the pits that swing up to slam creatures and knock them off the span.

datos.desactivar: Society DC 23 (expert) to locate the hidden deactivation switch or Thievery DC 30 (trained) to jam the mechanics on the span.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets over the course of the round and is ready to swing again 1 round later. It can be manually reset if Disabled.

it-pours.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
it-pours.descripcion: Water splashes within an ornate 5-foot-tall amphora. The glossy exterior depicts images of a marid trapped in a cage of flames, the frightened creature waving their hands in warning.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (trained) to scrape the flames away from the marid's image (requires two successes); Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 25) to disrupt the magical prison, disabling the trap for 10 minutes; or touch the amphora with Rayyan's seal to free the marid
datos.rutina: (1 action) The trap has one action per round by default, though it may gain more actions based on the encounter's scaling as listed in the sidebar. On each of the trap's actions, the amphora pours out water, increasing the depth of the water by 5 feet. Once the room is full of water, creatures in the room begin drowning, and the trap deals 2d10+9 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude DC 25 save to each creature in the room on its action as the water pressure increases.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets if 2 minutes pass without a creature inside the room.

keystone-trap.descripcion: A 5-foot-square metal vault covered with knobs lies concealed within a stone block. A lever on the stone block slides the vault into view. When the vault is exposed-whether it's slid out or whether the stone is smashed open-the trap activates.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 24 (trained) to find and press hidden knobs in a specific order (three successes are required to disable the trap, which also opens it); Crafting DC 24 (expert) to sabotage the vault's mechanisms, reducing its actions by 1 (when the trap's actions are reduced to 0, it is disabled)
datos.rutina: The keystone uses its 3 actions to Electrify, Spin, and then Launch Darts. When the trap loses an action, roll randomly to determine which action it loses.

last-prayers-of-the-doomed.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
last-prayers-of-the-doomed.descripcion: Influenced by the last prayers of the dead, creatures experience extreme claustrophobia and batter at the walls and floor, desperate to escape, see the sun, and breathe fresh air—but their prayers go unanswered.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 26 (expert) to disrupt the haunt through prayer, or Deception DC 26 or Diplomacy DC 26 DC 27 (expert) to convince the spirits you'll free them from this place
datos.reinicio: The haunt reforms after 1 day.

life-magnet.descripcion: A magical magnet hidden behind a panel in the corner of the room pulls not metal but living creatures toward it, heedless of any obstacles in the way.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 29 (expert) to deactivate the panel, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the panel's magic
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The trap pulls up to four creatures that have already triggered its Magnetize the Living ability toward one of the far corners of the room, possibly pressing them into the iron bars. If all the iron bars between an affected creature and the magnetic panel remain intact, the creature takes 2d10+10 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude DC 25 save and is Restrained on a failure ().

If an iron bar has been broken, the creature takes 1d10+5 bludgeoning damage instead, and if two consecutive bars have been broken the creature takes no damage (but might still be restrained on a failed save).
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets 1 minute after there are no creatures touching the iron bars.

lightlock.descripcion: The strange fog layer on the walls swirls and churns, then suddenly fires several beams of dark mist into the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (master) to disrupt some of the hidden runes that focus the trap's energies, or Dispel Magic (4th rank, counteract DC 25) or any spell with the Light trait to counteract the trap
datos.reinicio: The lightlock takes 1 minute to restore its energy, after which it can be triggered again.

mana-whorl.descripcion: This 15-foot-wide patch of destabilized sand attempts to submerge creatures who wield magic. A desert tree with dense bright green foliage, pale pink blooms, and at least one carnivorous red-chested magpie is always nearby.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 26 (expert) to feed magic into the whorl and temporarily stabilize it for a few minutes; feed the whorl a number of spellcasters and magic items with a combined 10 levels (for instance, a 4th-level cleric with two 3rd-level magic items) to stabilize it for 1 week; or feed the whorl a number of spellcasters and magic items with a combined 20 levels to stabilize it permanently. Spellcasters and magic items fed to the whorl are devoured whole.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its initiative, the whorl pulls down any creature within it that can cast spells or that is wielding a magic item. A creature submerged to the waist becomes submerged to the neck, and a creature submerged to the neck is pulled under and must hold its breath to avoid suffocation. If a creature has no spells or magic items, the mana whorl is merely difficult terrain. A creature caught in a mana whorl can attempt a Athletics DC 23 check to Swim to either raise itself by one step if submerged to the neck or worse, or to move 5 feet if submerged only to the waist. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down by one step. A creature that Swims out of the whorl escapes the hazard and is Prone in a space adjacent to the whorl. Other creatures can Aid the creature, typically by using a rope or similar aid, or attempt to pull the creature out with their own Athletics DC 23 check, with the same results as if the creature attempted the check. If a creature has only magic items and no ability to cast spells, dropping all the items releases that creature, and it can move through the mana whorl as normal difficult terrain.
datos.reinicio: The hazard continues to suck in anyone with magic until it is satiated (see Disable above). Magpies leave any satiated whorls.

mist-projector-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm
mist-projector-trap.descripcion: Hidden jets expel gas that quickly freezes, causing limited damage to nearby books.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (expert) to deactivate the trap without its control key or Crafting DC 26 to create and apply a chemical that neutralizes the gas.
datos.reinicio: 8 hours

murderous-crowd.descripcion: Concerned citizens shout slogans about the dangers of dealing with Cheliax and throw bricks at Chelaxian sympathizers.

datos.desactivar: Succeed at two of the following checks in any combination: Athletics DC 27 (trained) to confiscate dangerous debris, Diplomacy DC 27 (trained) to calm the crowd, Intimidation DC 25 (untrained) to scare the crowd away, Will DC 30 (trained) to maintain a brave and confident demeanor; an effect such as Calm that can target an area counts as one automatic success.
datos.rutina: (three actions) The unruly crowd uses an action to chant a Catchy Slogan if it is not already benefiting from the effect It uses Shake Confidence once per turn and uses its remaining actions for cobblestone Strikes.

natron-eruption.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-14: The Tomb Between Worlds
natron-eruption.descripcion: Negative-energy charged natron sprays out of the tub and starts to mummify nearby creatures.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (trained) to safely remove the umbral vise from the tub without triggering the natron or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract the ritual energy.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 24 hours.

overloading-arch-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
overloading-arch-5-6.descripcion: The Eternity Arch sparks with electricity, releasing bolts of lightning at each of the four largest time rifts.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (trained) or Arcana DC 25, Nature DC 25, Occultism DC 25, or Religion DC 25 (trained) to seal each of the four time rifts, Crafting DC 27 (trained) to divert the lightning to another source, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract each time rift.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each disabled time rift. On each of the trap's actions, the Eternity Arch releases a bolt of lightning that activates that rift, dealing 2d10 electricity damage to all creatures in a 10-foot emanation around the time rift (basic Reflex DC 25 save). It can release a bolt at each active time rift no more than once each turn.

planar-cracks-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-16: Freedom for Wishes
planar-cracks-7-8.descripcion: The cracks scintillate and shift between the elemental planes, leaking perilous energy with each shift.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) twice to assemble a seal using objects strongly grounded to the Material Plane, Arcana DC 26 (trained) twice to invoke incantations to seal the cracks, or Dispel Magic (4th rank, counteract DC 22) to counteract the cracks.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) A surge of energy strikes a random non-mephit creature in the foyer. Roll 1d4 to determine the element of the energy surge.

1-Energy from the Plane of Air: the creature takes 2d10+3 electricity damage (basic Reflex DC 25 save); on a failure, the creature is pushed back 10 feet toward the entryway. The hazard gains the air and electricity traits for this round.

2-Energy from the Plane of Earth: the creature takes 2d10+3 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex DC 25 save); on a failed save, the creature is knocked Prone. The hazard gains the earth trait for this round.

3-Energy from the Plane of Fire: the creature takes 2d10+9 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 25 save). The hazard gains the fire trait for this round.

4-Energy from the Plane of Water: the creature takes 2d10+3 cold damage (basic Reflex DC 25 save); on a failed save, the creature's lungs fill with water, making them Sickened 2. The hazard gains the cold and water traits for this round.
datos.reinicio: The cracks re-form after 1 hour.

powerful-ritual-effects.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-14: Twice in Steel
powerful-ritual-effects.descripcion: The effects of Hesla's profane ritual ripple outward through Deskari's Gullet. Physical tremors shake the cavern complex, while magical waves of energy affect those opposed to her actions.

datos.desactivar: This hazard persists until Hesla's ritual is complete and her demonic forces defeated.
datos.rutina: (two actions) The ground shakes, and waves of demonic energy surge through the cavern. Each PC must make a save against tremors and a save against demonic energy. Enemy combatants must only make the Reflex save against tremors; they are immune to the Demonic Energy effects.

prison-break.descripcion: A prison mob makes a break for freedom, trampling anything in its path.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 27 to stop the prisoners in their tracks, Diplomacy DC 30 to reason with the mob, or Intimidation DC 27 to cow them into calming down
datos.rutina:
(1 action) Prisoners trample toward the exit, dealing 2d10+9 bludgeoning damage to each living creature in area K9 and the hallway north of it (basic Reflex DC 25 save). On a critical failure, the creature's grasp on anything it's carrying is weakened as if the hazard succeeded on a Disarm attempt. If its grasp was already weakened, they drop the item.
Special If the PCs have not defeated the hazard after 4 rounds, it automatically ends as all the prisoners escape.

releasing-laibuson.descripcion: Five colorful gemstones circle the glass barrier separating the PCs from the quartermaster. Careful manipulation of the gems, which can be turned like knobs, might overload one or more of them.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 27 or Occultism DC 27 or Thievery DC 30 on the circle of gemstones to deactivate one gemstone, extinguishing its glow. A critical success on the check deactivates two gemstones, while a failure triggers the trap and a critical failure not only triggers the trap but resets a previously disabled gemstone. When all five gemstones are deactivated or destroyed, the trap becomes inert, releasing Laibuson.
datos.rutina: (1 action; arcane, mental) On its turn, the trap continues to antagonize Laibuson and one randomly determined PC, causing 4d8 mental damage (basic Will DC 25 save) to each. On a critical failure, the creature also becomes Stupefied 1 for the remainder of this vision.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates if a round passes without any attempts to disable or damage the gems, then resets and can reactivate again immediately.

sailor-s-warning-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
sailor-s-warning-7-8.descripcion: An illusory cyclops in oracular robes cries out a warning, but then dissolves into a violent phantasmal cyclops, which calls out for the Blind Formless Chaos That Lies Behind the Stars to accept his sacrifice. It then plunges an obsidian athame into a creature's chest, summoning a foul entity.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 25 (trained) to repair Chamenaiti's magic, Religion DC 27 or Occultism DC 27 (trained) to offset the prayer, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract the warning
datos.rutina: a Rubbery crimson tentacles appear from a rip in the air and grasp at all creatures in the area, dealing 2d8 bludgeoning,2d8 acid damage (basic Fortitude DC 25 save).

scouring-pool.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-16: The Heart of the City
scouring-pool.descripcion: The swirling water in this pool entices anyone who can see or hear it to wander into its depths, drowning its victims.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 to scratch out the runes creating the effect, Occultism DC 23 (expert) or Demon-lore DC 23 (expert) to determine the password that identifies the party as believers, or Dispel Magic (3rd-rank; counteract DC 25); two total successes are required to deactivate the pool.
datos.rutina:
(1 action; mental) The cleansing pool uses its first action to try and compel all creatures within 5 feet to enter into the pool. Creatures must attempt a Will DC 23 save.

—
Critical Success The creature is immune to the pool's routine for 1 minute.
Success No effect.
Failure The creature gains the Fascinated condition and attempts to enter the pool.
Critical Failure As failure, but the creature must also use all of their actions on their next turn to try and pull one of their allies into the pool with them.

serpent-ward.fuente: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind
serpent-ward.descripcion: Illusionary snakes erupt from the trapped door, inflicting a venomous curse on intruders.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert) or Occultism DC 24 (expert) to deactivate the magical trigger

shadow-discharge.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
shadow-discharge.descripcion: The shadow beacon's operation causes harmful energy to blast out of the base of the device.

datos.desactivar:
Crafting DC 27 or Thievery DC 27 (master) to rig a dispersal system, or Arcana DC 27, Nature DC 27, Occultism DC 27, or Religion DC 27 (master) to safely vent the magical energy; four total successes in any combination to disable

—
Special Disabling the shadow discharge does not disable the shadow beacon.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The shadow beacon fires shadows into the sky, discharging excess energy out of the device's lower half.
