The trap deals 4d6 cold,4d6 void damage to all non-shadow creatures in a 60-foot emanation from the base of the device (basic Fortitude DC 26 save). For each successful check to disable the trap, the cold and void damage dealt by the trap on subsequent rounds are both reduced by 1d6 damage (see below). A creature that fails their save is pushed back 10 feet (15 feet on a critical failure).
3d6 cold,3d6 void
2d6 cold,2d6 void
1d6 cold,1d6 void

shadow-spears-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-19: Mean Streets of Shadow Absalom
shadow-spears-7-8.descripcion: Invisible runes are concealed within an elaborate light-woven floor mosaic.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (trained) to remove pieces from the mosaic without triggering the magic or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the rune

shocking-malfunction.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
shocking-malfunction.descripcion: The shadow beacon malfunctions, firing bolts of electricity across the battlefield.

datos.desactivar:
Crafting DC 25 or Thievery DC 25 (master) to ground the device, or Arcana DC 25, Nature DC 25, Occultism DC 25, or Religion DC 25 (master) to safely vent the magical energy; three total successes in any combination to disable
Special Disabling the shocking malfunction does not disable the shadow beacon.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The shadow beacon makes three electric bolt Strikes at random creatures within 100 feet. One of these Strikes targets either Deg or Nizca, and the other two target PCs. The trap loses 1 action for each successful disable.

singe-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
singe-7-8.descripcion: Singe's spirit lingers in the Whippoorwill's crow's nest, where it calls out warnings and shoots intruders.

datos.desactivar: Pathfinder-society-lore DC 27 (trained) to persuade Singe that you are Pathfinders or Religion DC 27(trained) to perform rites to lay Singe to rest; two total successes are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: d Singe uses its first action(s) to make a long gun Strike against a random creature in the area. It uses its final action for Lookout's Warning. If the PCs successfully use Pathfinder Society Lore to Disable the haunt, Singe loses an action to make a long gun Strike.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

skulls-of-fear-and-flame.descripcion: A line of skulls adorned with black candles sit on the floor, and use darkvision to spot intruders. The red arrows on the map indicate the direction the skulls are looking.

datos.desactivar: Stealth DC 27 to move through the room unseen by the skulls (this does not disable the trap but does prevent it from triggering), Thievery DC 27 three times to "blind" an adjacent skull by deftly scraping hidden runes away from the inside of the eye sockets, or Dispel Magic (4th rank, counteract DC 25) to counteract the trap
datos.rutina: (6 actions) On its initiative the trap uses its first action to rotate a skull that can't see targets a full 360 degrees, stopping as soon as the skull spots a target. It repeats this action until all six skulls are looking at targets, then uses its remaining actions to shoot beams of fire from their eyes. The trap can only target a creature once per round, so if there are fewer targets than actions, any additional actions possessed by the trap are lost. The trap loses one action for each skull that is destroyed.
datos.reinicio: If there are no visible targets, the trap deactivates at the end of its turn, then automatically resets.

snake-s-mane.descripcion: A tangle of feathery green vines appears innocuous but fires a spray of acidic barbs at anything that disturbs it.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 27 (expert) to strip the barbs from the vines, rendering them harmless, or Stealth DC 30 (trained) to move through the snake's mane without disturbing it
datos.reinicio: 1 hour, as the vine grows a new set of barbs

spiritual-disruptor.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
spiritual-disruptor.descripcion: A flickering humanoid shape with four gold eyes, clad in red robes with black sleeves and wielding a torch that burns with red fire and smoke, strides purposefully across the ground, creating distortions in reality around it that cause wood to twist and decay and sends agonizing pain through the flesh.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 23 (expert) to disrupt the haunt's concentration in the living world and break its link to the mindscape, Religion DC 27 (expert) to banish the energy from the mindscape, or Occultism DC 30 (expert) to turn the haunt's energy back against itself to cancel it out
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The spiritual disruptor's first action each round is always to create a pulse of rippling energy in a 10-foot emanation that causes the surrounding structure to appear to age rapidly and become distorted, causing the ground in this area to become difficult terrain. If the spiritual disruptor is adjacent to a living target, it attempts to disrupt that target's life energy by making a Strike with its smoking torch. If the spiritual disruptor isn't adjacent to a living target, it Strides toward the closest target. If it has multiple adjacent targets, the spiritual disruptor favors higher-level targets, selecting randomly from multiple adjacent equal-level targets.
datos.reinicio: If both hazards are disabled or destroyed, a new one forms adjacent to a randomly determined character still inside the crumbling building after  rounds. Once all three NPCs are rescued or exorcised, these hazards don't reset.

sportlebore.descripcion: A sportlebore hides amid the victuals on a plate of food or within a pack of trail rations.

datos.desactivar: A creature that notices the sportlebore can remove it from the food it is hidden within automatically as an Interact action.

stalker-summoning-rune.descripcion: The sand conceals a rune that summons an invisible stalker into this yard.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 25 to approach without triggering the trap followed by Arcana DC 25 (expert) or Thievery DC 27 (expert) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 24 hours.

steaming-fields-5-6.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-24: Lightning Strikes, Stars Fall
steaming-fields-5-6.descripcion: A field of warm mist covers an open plain. Pockets of highly pressurized steam lie Hidden in the earth; pressure releases jets of steam.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 26 (expert) twice to navigate a safe path

stonegutter-mold.descripcion: A hardy, innocuous-looking green mold grows over surfaces, slowly absorbing minerals.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 26 (trained) to scrape away the mold without touching it
datos.reinicio: 1 hour, as the mold settles back across the surface.

tempest-forged-chains.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
tempest-forged-chains.descripcion: Brightly polished copper chains rumble with distant thunder and statically charge the air.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (expert) to release the lock, or Arcana DC 27 or Nature DC 27 (expert) to harmlessly release the storm's energy
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 hour.

temporal-warp.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
temporal-warp.descripcion: Just as a fight begins, time suddenly seems to break in the area, causing some elements to freeze in place and others to slow down or speed up, imparting a disjointed and nightmarish sensation upon those present.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 27 to cause the hazard to fade away and release all those affected by it from the hazard's effects, or Intimidation DC 30 to shock a single adjacent creature out of the distortion and free them from the hazard's effects.

test-of-the-god-caller.descripcion: An incorporeal Sarkorian deity manifests before the party and challenges their resolve. Only aspirants whose motives are pure and whose hearts are in tune with the natural world can hope to overcome this "test of the god caller."

datos.desactivar: Three Nature DC 27 or Occultism DC 27 (trained) checks can disable the haunt
datos.rutina:
(3 actions) The Sarkorian divinity commands a swarm of ghostly animals to overwhelm creatures in a 10-foot burst in the well. The haunt can select up to three different points to target, spending 1 action per burst. Creatures in an affected take 4d6 force and must attempt a Will DC 25 save. The haunt loses 1 action for each successful check to disable the haunt.

—

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is Off-Guard until the beginning of the haunt's next turn.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is off-guard until the beginning of the haunt's next turn, and is Slowed 1 for 1 round.
datos.reinicio: 8 hours

the-ketos.descripcion: A shadow the size of an island appears in the water beneath the ship.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 27, Athletics DC 27, or Diplomacy DC 27 or Sailing-lore DC 23 to help the crew of the Tide Hunter escape the Ketos; three total successes are required to disable the hazard
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The Ketos uses its actions to make tentacle Strikes against creatures aboard the Tide Hunter or within 30 feet of the ship.
datos.reinicio: If three or more of its tentacles are destroyed, the Ketos releases the Tide Hunter and disappears into the ocean's depths to nurse its wounds. The monster does not return to this area for 24 hours.

the-power-of-faith.descripcion: The lingering essence of the dwarven worshippers who established this shrine demand deference to Torag and punish those who don't offer it.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 27 (trained) to calm the lingering essence, Religion DC 23 (expert) to perform the required obeisance, or Thievery DC 30 (expert) to disrupt and redirect the essence harmlessly.
datos.rutina:
(3 actions; divine, enchantment, mental) Ghostly images of chanting dwarves float through the room, drifting between the creatures in the chamber. As they float, they use their 3 actions to target up to three different creatures in the room, touching their brows and filling that person's head with overwhelming but entirely mental choirs exalting the glory of Torag. The haunt targets Prone creatures before other creatures, and a single creature cannot be targeted more than once per round. A targeted creature must attempt a Will DC 25 save; prone creatures take a -2 penalty on this saving throw.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 1d10 mental damage from the cacophonous choir in their head.

Failure The creature takes 2d10+9 mental damage from the cacophonous choir in their head.

Critical Failure The creature takes 3d10+18 mental damage from the cacophonous choir in their head and is knocked prone.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates as soon as no living creatures are in area A4, then resets after 1 hour has passed. It can be permanently destroyed by clearing the fortress of all creatures that don't follow Torag and rededicating it to the god with a Consecrate ritual.

they-grow-inside.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
they-grow-inside.descripcion: When the bin is opened, it collapses, spilling out the infested corpse within.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 23 (expert) to reinforce the bin so it doesn't collapse (although if the PCs then search the remains, they still trigger the hazard), Religion DC 27 (master) to exorcise the haunt.

thieves-lament.descripcion: A rune inscribed on the inside of the lock releases a burst of flame that burns the thief's hands and their tools.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (expert) to scratch out the rune, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the runes

thunderstone-cascade-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God
thunderstone-cascade-trap.descripcion: A trip wire halfway up the stairs releases half a dozen spherical thunderstones that bounce down the stairs and explode.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (expert) to safely cut the trip wire

toxic-crystals.descripcion: The green crystals begin to pulse more brightly with light in the presence of living creatures. These fluctuations in illumination from different crystals eerily match the pace of the breathing and rhythm of the heartbeats of those in the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (expert) to create a chain reaction among the crystals by striking them in precise spots that cause them to shatter and harmlessly discharge their energy, or Performance DC 27 (expert) to use a musical instrument or singing to resonate the crystals and discharge their toxic energy harmlessly
datos.rutina:
(1 action) (light, poison) Each round on their action, the toxic crystals emit a shrill humming sound and flash brightly with green light. All creatures in area E14 or within the first 10 feet of either passage leading out of this area must attempt a Fortitude DC 25 save.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 2d8 poison damage.

Failure The creature takes 4d8 poison damage and is Dazzled for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes 4d8 poison damage, becomes Enfeebled 1, and is Blinded for 1 minute.
datos.reinicio: The toxic crystals become dormant once no living creatures are in range, but can activate again as soon as another living creature comes in range.

turbulent-koi-egg.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-11: The Godsrain and the Dragon
turbulent-koi-egg.descripcion: A raging storm covers the mountain lake as spring water levitates from the lake to fall back down in a driving spiral of steaming rain. In the depths of the storm, barely visible, is a tiny koi egg surrounded by three bands of water.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 27, Religion DC 27, Nature DC 27, or Occultism DC 27 to purify the magic corrupting the ascension ritual, or Diplomacy DC 30 or Performance DC 30 to soothe the spirit within the koi egg and give it the strength to fight off the corruption itself; four total successes are required to purify the ritual, each of the first three successes purifying one ring of water and the final one halting the ritual itself. If the cursed comb has not been removed from the ritual site, then succeeding on this final check merely halts the ritual; if the cursed comb has been removed from the ritual site, then succeeding on this final check completes the ascension ritual.
datos.rutina: (1 action) Torrential water descends from the sky, taking the shape of a dragon that smashes into one creature within 60 feet of the egg. The dragon always targets the creature that is closest to the egg, dealing 2d10 bludgeoning damage and 2d10 fire damage in a spray of boiling water (Fortitude DC 26 save). Creatures that fail the save are pushed 10 feet away. Creatures that have the earth trait, are carrying an item with the earth trait, or are otherwise strongly tied to elemental earth (such as an earth elemental sorcerer or kineticist) get the result one degree of success better than the outcome of their save, as the power of elemental earth overcomes water.
datos.reinicio: The turbulent koi egg can attempt to hatch again, restarting the ascension ritual, after 1000 years of Xalreonshin's care.

waking-nightmare.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-17: Dreams of a Dustbound Isle
waking-nightmare.descripcion: Faceless statues struggle against each other to stay above the black dust.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 24 (expert) to urge the statues to work together, Intimidation DC 27 (expert) to Coerce the statues away, or Occultism DC 30 (trained) to oppose the psychic influence. Each check to disable the haunt is a two-action activity; three total successes are required to disable the haunt.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On the haunt's initiative, creatures in the area sink deeper into the dust as statues grasp at them. Creatures in the area take 2d10+9 mental damage (basic Will DC 25 saving throw). On a critical failure, the creature is also Confused for 1 round. Creatures Grabbed by the haunt take a -1 circumstance penalty to their saving throw.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

weight-of-guilt.descripcion: Influenced by the guilt and regrets of the dead, creatures are wrapped in weighted chains that embody their own sins.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 26 (expert) to disrupt the haunt through prayer or Deception DC 27 (expert) to openly defy your regrets and banish the haunt. Creatures who haven't committed sins or already made amends for their transgressions are immune to the effects of this haunt.
datos.reinicio: 1 day

whispers-from-long-ago.descripcion: As the door is opened, unsettling whispering radiates outward, worming its way into the mind of the one who dared intrude.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 27 (master) to deface the subtly hidden triggering runes around the door's circumference, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the trap
datos.reinicio: The trap resets over the course of a round and is ready to whisper at the next person who attempts to open the door 1 round later.

wind-surge.descripcion: Hurricane-force winds rip through the area as Agyra flies past.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 27 (expert) or Acrobatics DC 27 (expert) to crouch and contort out of the wind's way (disables the hazard for only yourself), Survival DC 30 to point out a safe space from the winds for up to 3 creatures.

wrathful-hatchet.descripcion: The hatchet embedded atop the desk wiggles, vibrates, and then flies into the air, accompanied by a rage-filled cry of a woman.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 27 to soothe the haunt's wrath or Religion DC 25 to exorcise the haunt
datos.rutina:
(3 actions; evocation, occult) The haunted hatchet uses an action to move to a square adjacent to a creature within 25 feet, attempts a wrathful hatchet Strike against an adjacent creature, or attempts to Escape from being immobilized or restrained. If there are no creatures within 25 feet, the hatchet moves in a random direction.

If it ends its turn and there are no creatures within 25 feet, the hatchet falls to the ground, and the haunt ends.
datos.reinicio: 24 hours; putting Xarwin's ghost to rest destroys this haunt forever.

accursed-cargo-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
accursed-cargo-7-8.descripcion: A wooden crate bearing a chthonic sigil glows with a power contained within it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (trained) to open the crate with gradual release of its magical energy, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 24) to dispel the rune

angry-void-boils.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-17: Dreams of a Dustbound Isle
angry-void-boils.descripcion: Tumor-like growths erupt from the isle as it responds to psychic attack, spewing black lightning and fire in every direction.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 28 (trained) to reshape the substance of the dream, or Performance DC 32 (trained) or Religion DC 30 (trained) to invoke Desna's blessing through hymns or prayers. Each check to disable the hazard is a two-action activity; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On the hazard's initiative, a boil erupts from the ground and bursts. This blast strikes as many enemies as possible in a 15-foot burst anywhere on the isle, dealing 5d8 force damage (basic Reflex DC 26 or basic Will DC 26, target's choice) to enemies in the area. Aslynn avoids targeting the nightmares with the blast.

anguished-sarenite.descripcion: The gold religious symbol of a former priest of Sarenrae is haunted by the priest's tormented soul.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 28 to bring the spirit to its senses, or Religion DC 24 (expert) to banish it
datos.reinicio: 1 day

blood-draining-lock.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
blood-draining-lock.descripcion: A spring-loaded blade hidden in the door's handle stabs anyone attempting to turn it, dealing unholy wounds that bleed profusely. Disabling or breaking the trap does not disable or break the lock.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 31 (expert) on the spring mechanism

blowing-off-steam.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-20: The Rakshasa's Court
blowing-off-steam.descripcion: Hidden vents emit scalding hot steam made from a particularly acrid solution, irritating the eyes and throat of anyone who inhales it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 29 (trained) to block a vent, or Crafting DC 27 (trained) to disable the heating element within the vent that turns the liquid into steam
datos.rutina: (4 actions) Each of the four steam vents uses a single action each to emit superheated steam, which spreads for 60 feet along the wall from its location and extends out from the wall by 30 feet, dealing 2d10+11 untyped damage to each creature in their range (Fortitude DC 26 save). For each disabled vent, the trap loses 1 action each turn.
datos.reinicio: The steam vents cease to operate 1 minute after all creatures have left the area and go into a maintenance cycle for 1 hour. After this time, they can be triggered again.

camouflaged-spiked-pit.descripcion: A 20-foot deep, funnel-shaped pit with dozens of wooden spikes lining its walls.

datos.desactivar: Yanking the cloth away is a simple way to expose the danger to allow someone to merely avoid it by walking around its edges, but it cannot be quickly disabled.
datos.reinicio: Creatures can still fall into the trap once it has been exposed, but the camouflaged cover must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.

carbauxine-gas-deposit.descripcion: A colorless, odorless, and highly flammable gas fills the area.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 28 (trained) to disperse the gas safely
datos.reinicio: The gas builds up over the course of 24 hours, after which it can trigger again.

cave-in--pathfinder-195-heavy-is-the-cro.descripcion: The rubble shifts and the cavern ceiling collapses.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 28 (expert) or Survival DC 31 (trained) to prop up the cavern ceiling without triggering a collapse.

collapsing-ramp-9-10.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-22: Breaking the Storm: Excising Ruination
collapsing-ramp-9-10.descripcion: Abyssal fire hits the stone beneath the ramp, causing a 15-foot-long section of it to collapse.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 31 (expert) to stabilize the masonry. Each attempt takes 2 actions.

constricting-hall.descripcion: A hall's four walls become fluid and elastic when a creature reaches the hall's midpoint.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (trained) to stabilize each wall, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract each wall
datos.rutina: (4 actions) This trap loses 1 action each round for each wall that has been disabled. Each wall uses 1 action to slam back and forth rapidly, pummeling one creature in the hall with a wall Strike. On a hit, the target is additionally knocked Prone. The walls distribute the attacks as evenly as possible among creatures in the hall, and the Strikes don't apply the trap's multiple attack penalty.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 hour.

corrupted-draft.descripcion: Discordant music, dance, and poetry combine to build a deep suspicion and distrust of strangers.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 28 to counteract the performance or Religion DC 28 or Occultism DC 28 to disrupt the spiritual energy. Two total successes are needed to disable the trap. The mechanical head can automatically disable the trap with two uses of Inspired Recitation.
datos.rutina:
(1 action; emotion, fear, mental, occult) The echoes continue to reverberate, tearing at those in the area and filling them with distrust of others. All creatures in the area take 2d10+11 mental damage and must attempt a Will DC 28 save.

—
Critical Success The target is unaffected and is immune to the effects for 1 minute.
Success The target takes half damage.
Failure The target takes full damage and is Sickened 1 by feelings of distrust and anxiety.
Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is Sickened 2.
datos.reinicio: The hazard stops when there are no conscious creatures in area E3 and resets after 1 minute.

cruel-welcome.descripcion: A loved one, tied to a post with thick ropes, suddenly lurches to life and begins to shriek in anguish as soon as one of the PCs comes within 20 feet.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 31 (expert) to remove the small runes carved on the pole that focus the magic, or Occultism DC 28 (trained) to recognize the occult illusions woven into the trap and disable the underlying magic
datos.rutina:
(1 action; illusion, mental, occult, visual) The cruel welcome's head lifts, and it gazes at the closest PC within 20 feet; if there are no PCs in range, the trap does nothing, its turn ends, and it deactivates until midnight. The target must attempt a Will DC 26 save.

—
Critical Success The PC is unaffected. For the next 24 hours, the PC gains a +4 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against cruel welcome traps.
Success The PC recognizes the face of the tormented figure on the pole as that of a loved one, and the anguish of the sight results in 4d10 mental damage. For the next 24 hours, the PC gains a +4 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against cruel welcome traps.
Failure As success, but 4d10+22 mental damage.
Critical Failure As failure, but 8d10+44 mental damage, and the PC becomes Stupefied 1 for 24 hours.
datos.reinicio: A cruel welcome trap resets at midnight.

dead-organ-7-8.descripcion: A magical pipe organ for controlling and bolstering the undead. Creatures that are trained in Performance can spend one action to attempt to play a tune.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) to stopper the pipes. Each pipe stoppered imparts a stacking -1 circumstance penalty to Performance checks with the organ. Once four pipes have been stoppered, the organ ceases to function.

demilich-skull.descripcion: The skull of a defeated demilich is haunted by souls of the demilich's victims.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 26, Occultism DC 26, Nature DC 26, or Religion DC 26 to counteract the skull's Broken Gems
datos.reinicio: 1 day

electric-fence.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
electric-fence.descripcion: A locked, wrought iron fence with bars spaced inches apart is magically electrified.

datos.desactivar: Crafting or Thievery DC 28 (expert) to disconnect the fence from its magitech power source
datos.reinicio: The trap automatically resets. If deactivated or disabled, the trap doesn't reset.

electrified-water-ward.fuente: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind
electrified-water-ward.descripcion: Passing over an invisible rune on the floor between the north and south doors triggers a dancing burst of electricity.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert), Arcana DC 28 (expert), or Occultism DC 28 (expert) to harmlessly bleed away the electrical energy from the rune. Once the trap has been activated, the electrical energy is stronger, so three successful checks (of any combination of the relevant skills) are necessary to deactivate it, but these checks can be attempted from anywhere in the room.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The trap deals 4d10 electricity damage (basic Reflex DC 26 save) to all creatures in the room. A creature that fails the save is Slowed 1 (Slowed 2 on a critical failure). A creature that isn't touching the water treats the result of its saving throw as one degree of success better.
datos.reinicio: The pulses stop as soon as no creatures are in the hallway, and then reset after 1 hour.

empowered-turbulent-koi-egg.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-11: The Godsrain and the Dragon
empowered-turbulent-koi-egg.descripcion: A raging storm covers the mountain lake as spring water levitates from the lake to fall back down in a driving spiral of steaming rain. In the depths of the storm, barely visible, is a tiny koi egg surrounded by three bands of water.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 28, Religion DC 28, Nature DC 28, or Occultism DC 28 to purify the magic corrupting the ascension ritual, or Diplomacy DC 31 or Performance DC 31 to soothe the spirit within the koi egg and give it the strength to fight off the corruption itself; four total successes are required to purify the ritual, each of the first three successes purifying one ring of water and the final one halting the ritual itself. If the cursed comb has not been removed from the ritual site, then succeeding on this final check merely halts the ritual; if the cursed comb has been removed from the ritual site, then succeeding on this final check completes the ascension ritual.
datos.rutina: (1 action) Torrential water descends from the sky, taking the shape of a dragon that smashes into one creature within 60 feet of the egg. The dragon always targets the creature that is closest to the egg, dealing 2d10+2 bludgeoning damage and 2d10 fire damage in a spray of boiling water (Fortitude DC 28 save). Creatures that fail the save are pushed 10 feet away. Creatures that have the earth trait, are carrying an item with the earth trait, or are otherwise strongly tied to elemental earth (such as an earth elemental sorcerer or kineticist) get the result one degree of success better than the outcome of their save, as the power of elemental earth overcomes water.
datos.reinicio: The turbulent koi egg can attempt to hatch again, restarting the ascension ritual, after 1000 years of Xalreonshin's care.

endless-struggle.descripcion: Vicious spirits of the two owlbears, Eirikk, and the rest of the bandits rise and resume their final battle.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 24 (expert) three times to empathize with the bestial spirits that comprise the haunt and to calm them, or Religion DC 28 (expert) two times to exorcise the haunt and disperse its energy.
datos.rutina: (3 actions; emotion, fear, mental) The spectral violence churns and flashes through the room, targeting three separate creatures with ghostly claws, beaks, swords, and arrows. At the end of the haunt's turn, it takes its Spectral Uprising reaction.
datos.reinicio: The haunt resets after 24 hours; it can be permanently destroyed if it is either disabled or destroyed after the Beast itself has been slain.

exploding-bloom-pods.descripcion: Moving too quickly through the bed of pods causes them to shudder, emit eerie gurgling sounds, and then burst.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 28 (expert) (4 checks) to slice through all four of the larger shared root systems to render the dangerous pods inert, or inflict enough damage to the pods on the first attempt to reach the hazard's BT (damage that doesn't reach the hazard's broken threshold causes it to trigger)

freezing-floor.descripcion: The white brick floor radiates ice-cold air.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 24 (expert) to erase a rune, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24) to dispel a rune; all three runes must be erased or dispelled to disable the trap.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) With each action, the trap attempts a frost jet Strike against any creature standing on the white bricks. The trap loses 1 action per disabled or dispelled rune.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.

frenetic-musician.descripcion: A spirit musician rises out of an instrument and plays a frantic, bone-shaking melody.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 26 (trained) to bring the spirit's music to a close or Occultism DC 28 check (expert) to banish the spirit
datos.reinicio: 1 hour

furious-flame.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
furious-flame.descripcion: Religious sigils of Scal carefully carved into the doorframe capture Tokainen's suppressed anger and frustration, unleashing it in a destructive explosion when a creature attempts to open the door.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert) to scratch out the religious iconography, Religion DC 24 (trained) to pray for safe passage, Diplomacy DC 28 (expert) to soothe the emotions powering the magical ward, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the magical energy
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 minute.

ghost-crystal-cloud.fuente: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God
ghost-crystal-cloud.descripcion: The xulgath corpse splits open to release a cloud of tiny ectoplasmic crystals which, when they are inhaled, disorient and devitalize living creatures.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 26 or Occultism DC 26 (expert) to render the crystal cloud inert
datos.reinicio: The crystals regrow into a number sufficient to form another dangerous cloud after 1 week.

hall-of-mirrors.descripcion: Among the many mirrored reflections lurk three trapped souls. By attacking reflections, these spirits cause wounds to appear on the bodies of those reflected in the mirror. If a trapped soul kills its victim, the soul escapes the mirror, replaced by its victim's soul.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 24 (expert) to realign a mirror so a trapped soul can't hurt the reflections, Religion DC 28 (expert) to banish a trapped soul, or Thievery DC 28 (expert) to cover a mirror quickly enough to keep the trapped soul inside it; each successful attempt to disable the haunt reduces its number of actions by 1
datos.rutina: (3 actions) Each trapped soul makes a reflective rip Strike against the reflection of a creature in the room; each trapped soul must attack a different target.

hands-of-the-forgotten.descripcion: Ethereal hands stretch out from the walls and floor, attempting to restrain nearby creatures.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 30 (master) to exorcise the spirits or Intimidation DC 32 (expert) to scare away the hands

hidden-forest-bog-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-99: Blessings of the Forest
hidden-forest-bog-7-8.descripcion: A 15-foot wide area of verdant-covered water attempts to suck creatures down into it.

datos.desactivar: Two Survival DC 28 (trained) checks to find roots and tree limbs sturdy enough for everyone to use as escape paths ends the hazard's threat to all creatures in the area
datos.rutina:
(one action) On its initiative, the bog pulls down each creature within it. A creature that was submerged to its waist becomes submerged to its neck, and a creature that was submerged up to its neck is pulled under and must hold its breath to avoid suffocation.

A creature partially or fully submerged in the bog can attempt a Athletics DC 26 check to Swim to either raise itself by one step (pulled under to submerged to its neck, or submerged to its neck to submerged to its waist), or to escape from the bog if it's submerged only up to its waist. This DC increases to Athletics DC 28 for creatures submerged up to their neck or worse. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down one step. Other creatures can Aid, typically by using a rope or similar assistance (providing an automatic success), or attempt to pull a single affected creature out with their own Athletics check, with the same results as if the aiding creature attempted the check itself.
datos.reinicio: The hazard still submerges anyone who walks in, but the surface doesn't become hidden again until it accumulates leaf and greenery cover over the course of 24 hours.

history-s-repetition-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
history-s-repetition-7-8.descripcion: Pebbles form into a hand the size of an ox, which reaches to crush anyone in the water.

datos.desactivar: Thievery (trained) to recognize and recreate the battle
datos.reinicio: 24 hours

horrible-pond.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-14: Twice in Steel
horrible-pond.descripcion: The illusion of a normal, if dirty, pond is broken by clammy hands reaching up from the depths. While they never break the surface, travelers feel compelled to reach for the grasping fingers and willingly walk to their doom.

datos.desactivar: Deception DC 28, Diplomacy DC 28 or Religion DC 28 (expert) to calm the spirits; two successes required, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 28) to dispel the magic.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The pond attempts to Grab all PCs in the water with a {+18} Athletics bonus. Any Grabbed or Restrained PCs take 4d10+22 void (unholy) damage (basic Fortitude DC 28 save). All PCs within 30 feet must then make a save against Call of the Depths.
datos.reinicio: When there are no living humanoids within 30 feet of the pond, the hands recede into the depths and the pond resets.

hostile-architecture-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
hostile-architecture-7-8.descripcion: The sigils on the door's frame glow with an amber light, which collects in a facet over the center of the door.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 22 (trained) to strategically destroy the runes, Thievery DC 24 to disrupt the beam from collecting the facet, or Dispel Magic (4th rank, counteract DC 24) to dispel the rune
datos.rutina: a The hostile architecture fires its aversion beam on a creature that is sanctified holy. If there are no sanctified holy creatures, it instead fires its beam on the nearest non-demon creature.
datos.reinicio: The Hostile Architecture resets after being exposed to the light of a blue moon.

invertebrate-infiltrator-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm
invertebrate-infiltrator-trap.descripcion:
Variant confounding betrayal

Allies appear to shed their skin, transforming into either giant worm monsters or masses of wriggling worms.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) twice to suppress the trap's trigger, or Occultism DC 28 (expert) to create a ward against the trap's mental effects.
datos.rutina:
(1 action, illusion, incapacitation, occult) The haunt continues to confound victims' senses and inspire them to commit violence against each other. Each creature in the haunt's area must attempt a Will DC 26.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is confused for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is confused for 1 minute.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

iron-maiden-trap.descripcion: A pressure plate hidden on the floor before an iron maiden causes the torture device to snap shut and trap the triggering creature inside.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 to disable the pressure plate
datos.reinicio: The pressure plate must be reset manually.

it-s-never-enough.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
it-s-never-enough.descripcion: The smells and sights of fresh baked goods compel those who experience them to take part in a grisly feast.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 28 (trained) to draw upon memories of leaner times and counteract the temptation of the promised meal or Religion DC 31 (expert) to exorcise the haunt; 2 successes are required to disable it, and once the haunt is disabled, the food on the table is revealed to be foul, rotting, and moldy.
datos.rutina:
(1 action; mental) On its initiative, the haunt exudes mental compulsions to all living creatures in the room, driving them to take part in the offered feast. Each living creature in the room must attempt a Will DC 26 save with the following results. Food consumed during this hazard's routine is automatically replenished at the start of the next round.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature is compelled to approach the table of food and be seated. On the creature's turn, it Strides as often as needed to reach the table, then Interacts with a chair to be seated. If it has any remaining actions, it can use them normally (such as by Interacting again to stand up from being seated at the table).
Failure As success, but the creature must spend at least one of its actions this turn (if any are available after potentially approaching and taking a seat) Interacting with the food to eat some of it. Eating the food afflicts the creature with Rancid Breakfast.
Critical Failure As failure, but the creature must use any actions not used to approach the table or be seated at it to Interact and eat food.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates at the start of any round in which there are no living creatures in area D2, then reactivates 1 minute later.

join-us-forever.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
join-us-forever.descripcion: The skeletal remains in the cells clatter up to their feet and reach out toward visitors as they call out, inviting them to embrace the addiction of imprisonment.

datos.desactivar: Deception DC 26 (trained) to trick one of the skeletons into thinking they're free, or Religion DC 23 (expert) to exorcise a haunted skeleton; each success disables one of the four haunted skeletons.
datos.rutina:
(4 actions) Each of the four skeletons targets a living creature in area C37, reaches their arms out toward the target, and in a mournful yet strangely compelling voice invites the target to join them in imprisonment forever, promising blissful enlightenment in return for an eternity spent behind bars. The skeletons attempt to target a different living creature, but if there are more skeletons than targets, they randomly target identical creatures. Targeted creatures must attempt a Will DC 26 save, with a cumulative status penalty of –1 for each additional skeleton targeting them (to a maximum penalty of –3 if all four skeletons target a single creature), and the following results. This is an incapacitation and mental effect.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature is tempted to remain in the room, takes 2d6 mental damage, and becomes Slowed 1 until the end of its next turn.
Failure The creature is compelled to remain in the room, takes 5d6 mental damage, and becomes Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
Critical Failure The creature is compelled to remain in the room, takes 10d6 mental damage, becomes Stupefied 1 with an unlimited duration, and becomes paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates at the end of any round in which there are no living creatures in the room. It then resets 1 minute later.

krooth-summoning-rune.fuente: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God
krooth-summoning-rune.descripcion: The haze conceals a rune that summons a krooth in front of the door to area B10.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 24 to approach without triggering the trap followed by Thievery DC 26 (expert) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the rune.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 24 hours.

meddler-s-muddle.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
meddler-s-muddle.descripcion: A rune hidden in the door's decorative carvings delivers a telepathic jolt, draining will and muddling the mind.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert) to scratch out the rune without triggering a mental assault, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 minute.

methane-flue.descripcion: Invisible but highly flammable natural gas has built up beneath the ground, where geological pressure can ignite it.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 28 to dig around the vent in a way that diffuses the fumes

mushroom-ring-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-00: The King in Thorns
mushroom-ring-7-8.descripcion: This mushroom ring forms a portal to the First World, allowing the Thorned Monarch's reinforcements into the Material Plane. When the PCs approach, a creature emerges. Creatures continue to emerge until the mushroom ring is disabled. Disabling the mushroom ring also causes any creatures that have emerged to disappear.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 24 (expert) or Nature DC 28 (expert) to rearrange the mushrooms to disrupt the portal (two actions) or Dispel Magic (4th rank, counteract DC 26) to counteract the magical properties; three successes are required to disable the portal
datos.rutina: (1 Action) A Elananx emerges from the mushroom ring and defends it. All elananxes use the mushroom ring's initiative.

nahyndrian-focus.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-17: The Devil in the Details
nahyndrian-focus.descripcion: A metal lattice forged from warshards feeds into a dark purplish crystal that pulses with energy. If the configuration of the lattice changes, so does the energy the device emits.

datos.desactivar: Three  (see Disabling the Focus under Event 1 on page 18).
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The Nahyndrian Focus uses Select Condition to determine which condition it is going to inflict. It then uses Inflict twice, usually on two different targets. If the focus is broken, it is Slowed 1, and can only Inflict once per turn.

names-of-the-nameless.descripcion: The voices of the nameless dead intrude into the minds of the living.

datos.desactivar: Perception DC 26 to discern a name spoken by the nameless dead, or Religion DC 28 (expert) to put the nameless dead to rest. Speaking three names aloud disables the haunt. A creature that speaks any other name aloud must succeed at a Will DC 28 save or be Confused for 1 round.
datos.rutina: (1 action; auditory, divine, emotion, fear, mental) Spirits of the dead whisper their names into the minds of creatures in the room, dealing 2d10+11 mental damage (basic Will DC 28 save). A creature that fails the save is also Frightened 1 (or Frightened 2 on a critical failure).
datos.reinicio: If the haunt is disabled, divine light washes through the area. Living creatures in the area regain 4d8 healing Hit Points, and undead creatures in the area take 4d8 vitality damage. The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

painful-suggestion-trap.descripcion: A hidden rune on the floor under the filth, just past the threshold, triggers an ersatz ghost.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) to remove the rune without triggering it, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26) to dispel the rune
datos.reinicio: The trap automatically resets after 1 hour.

paralysis-trap.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
paralysis-trap.descripcion: Magical symbols carved in the doorframe magically ward this door; anyone attempting to pick the lock is Paralyzed and wracked with pain. Disabling or breaking the trap does not disable or break the lock.

datos.desactivar:
Thievery DC 28 (expert) to scratch out the magical symbols, Arcana DC 28 (expert) to safely siphon the magical energy, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26)
Bypass Anyone other than Mirida turns the door handle three times to the right and once to the left in quick succession.
datos.reinicio: The trap automatically resets. It doesn't reset if the trap is disabled.

paralyzing-light-trap.descripcion: When any creature other than a devil enters the light, the magic interwoven in the light holds the creature in place and rings an alarm.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (master) to distort or diffuse the light, keeping the light cone intact but preventing the trap from triggering, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26) to dispel the light, leaving the room in darkness
datos.rutina: (1 action) All Stunned and Paralyzed creatures in the room take 1d10 mental damage (basic Will DC 26 save). Creatures who fail also become paralyzed for 1 round but can use a reaction to mentally fight off this stasis; creatures who do so take 5d10 mental damage mental damage but are no longer paralyzed.
datos.reinicio: The stasis magic in the light builds up over the course of an hour, after which the trap can trigger again.

poisoned-skull.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
poisoned-skull.descripcion: A fast-acting toxin that's almost invisible to the eye coats the first and seventh skull on this display shelf.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 31 to identify the toxin and delicately wipe it free before burning the tainted cloth; on a critical success, the character can pinpoint two areas where the skull can be safely carried and, perhaps, used as an improvised thrown weapon to poison a creature.

poisonous-pollen-trap.descripcion: Flowers carved into the door emit colorful pollen when the door is touched.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert) to deface the flower carvings, Nature DC 25 (expert) to neutralize the pollen, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the conjuration
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 hour.

possessed-daeodons-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-15: Cleansing the Flame
possessed-daeodons-7-8.descripcion: Three daeodon corpses, animated and enraged by Sezelrian's divine intervention, trample anything within the ritual circle.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 24 or Religion DC 24 to disrupt the magic animating the spirits, Athletics DC 28 to hold down one of the daeodons, or Dispel Magic (4th-rank, counteract DC 28). 3 successes are required.
datos.rutina: (three actions) The animated daeodons trample all creatures within the circle, dealing 2d10+11 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex DC 25 save).
datos.reinicio: The hazard resets within 24 hours if the cultists of Sezelrian still remain in the area.

rage-of-the-sky-father.descripcion: Ominous storm clouds gather overhead, pulsating with flashes of blue-white lightning.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 23 (trained) to petition Gozreh for safe passage or Arcana DC 28, Nature DC 28, or Occultism DC 28 (expert) to disperse the storm's magical energies. A PC whose voice is exceptionally loud (such as using the Bullhorn cantrip) can also attempt to Disable this hazard with a Diplomacy DC 25 check to convince the Gozren priests that they mean no harm; the priests make a second prayer to dissipate the hazard on the following round, though they're unable to stop the sargassum heaps.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) (divine, electricity) A bolt of lightning strikes a 10-foot burst atop the plateau of the GM's choosing. Creatures in the area take 2d10+9 electricity damage (Reflex DC 28 save). On a critical failure, the creature is also Stunned 1. Creatures designated by Katlanthe within the area are infused with divine energy for 1 round. They gain the electricity trait and immunity to electricity damage, and all their attacks deal an additional 1d6 electricity damage.
Effect: Rage of the Sky Father
datos.reinicio: The storm clouds disperse once no creature other than those designated by Katlanthe are atop the plateau.

riftcarver.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-20: The Overthrow of Ambition
riftcarver.descripcion: Riftcarver is the chthonic artifact weapon of Deskari, the slain demon lord of the locust host and plague of the Worldwound (now known as the Sarkoris Scar). Unfettered from its creator, it now wreaks havoc on the enemies of its current master, Hesla Embersplitter.

datos.desactivar: Deception DC 24 (expert), Demon-lore DC 24 (trained), or Religion DC 24 (expert) to remind Riftcarver that it should not serve an interloper; Intimidation DC 28 (trained), Nature DC 28 (trained), or Occultism DC 28 (trained) to temporarily make Riftcarver's spirit cower; Dispel Magic (5th rank, counteract DC 25); three total successes are required to disable the hazard. The first time Riftcarver is taken away from Hesla Embersplitter against her will (via disarm, a spell, or some other method), it also counts as one success. If Hesla Embersplitter is rendered Unconscious or killed, the hazard immediately ends.
datos.rutina: (three actions) Riftcarver lives up to its name, using all three of its actions to carve a new rift in a random direction (rolling  to determine that direction). Hesla Embersplitter is immune to the effects of these rifts while wielding Riftcarver.

riftcarver-11-12.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-20: The Overthrow of Ambition
riftcarver-11-12.descripcion: Riftcarver is the chthonic artifact weapon of Deskari, the slain demon lord of the locust host and plague of the Worldwound (now known as the Sarkoris Scar). Unfettered from its creator, it now wreaks havoc on the enemies of its current master, Hesla Embersplitter.

datos.desactivar: Deception DC 27 (expert), Demon-lore DC 27 (trained), or Religion DC 27 (expert) to remind Riftcarver that it should not serve an interloper; Intimidation DC 32 (trained), Nature DC 32 (trained), or Occultism DC 32 (trained) to temporarily make Riftcarver's spirit cower; Dispel Magic (6th rank, counteract DC 28); three total successes are required to disable the hazard. The first time Riftcarver is taken away from Hesla Embersplitter against her will (via disarm, a spell, or some other method), it also counts as one success. If Hesla Embersplitter is rendered Unconscious or killed, the hazard immediately ends.
datos.rutina: (three actions) Riftcarver lives up to its name, using all three of its actions to carve a new rift in a random direction (rolling  to determine that direction). Hesla Embersplitter is immune to the effects of these rifts while wielding Riftcarver.

shoanti-ancestor-storm.descripcion: Smoke and fire explode up around the boundaries of the storm, accusatory screams and threats of violence echoing over the winds and crackling of flames. Broken weapons and shields litter the ground and Shoanti warriors emerge from the smoke, blood running down their faces as they prepare for battle.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 26 to redirect the anger of the haunt back onto itself, Intimidation DC 28 to goad the Shadefield spirits into attacking someone outside of the ritual circle, or Religion DC 28 to assuage the spirits in the area. Four successes are needed to disable the haunt long enough for the ritual to be completed.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The ancestor storm uses 1 action to release a pulse of void energy, restoring 10 healing Hit Points to each Shadefield spirit in the area, before using its next 2 actions to make an arrows of rage Strike against all non-Shoanti creatures within 60 feet of the cairn. The haunt then uses its 4th action to use Calling the Blood on one random leader participating in the ritual. The haunt loses an action for each Shadefield spirit killed, and when there are no Shadefield spirits remaining, the haunt uses its next action to summon a new Shadefield spirit into the battle.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the Shadefields but resets immediately. The haunt is only permanently disabled when Diskah Night Watcher is put to rest. Otherwise, the haunt reforms within 24 hours of being Disabled.

shuffling-scythe-blades.descripcion: Six long blades, hidden in grooves in the walls and floor, zigzag through different parts of this hallway when any pressure plate in the hallway intersection is depressed; there are so many plates it's impossible to avoid them when moving through the room. The blades retreat into the floor and move through the hidden grooves before swinging out from the wall again in a different location.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert) to disable each blade, or utter the magical passphrase (which only Chafkhem knows) to deactivate the trap for 10 minutes
datos.rutina: (7 actions) The trap spends 1 action for each of its blades; a blade makes a scythe Strike against each creature in its region. With its final action, the trap uses Scythe Shuffle. Reduce the number of actions the trap can take by 1 for each destroyed blade.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets when no creatures remain in area E20. Damaged or destroyed blades aren't repaired when the trap resets.

soporific-lecture.descripcion: Several hidden nozzles spray colorless sleeping gas into the seating area.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) to crimp shut the primary feeding tube for the gas, or Perception DC 31 (expert) to discover the hidden bypass switch next to the door to area A3 that shuts the trap off

sparking-oozeshardling-node.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-07: A God Falls Where Magic Fails
sparking-oozeshardling-node.descripcion: A lump of bluish ooze shot through with what look like tiny silver shavings of metal. Once it has been activated, it glows with arcs of electricity that leap out at nearby targets.

datos.desactivar: Two successful Arcana DC 23 or Occultism DC 23 (trained) checks on the oozeshardling to disperse its power, or Acrobatics DC 25 or Thievery DC 25 (expert) to remove the flecks of empowering warshard from within the oozeshardling. A failed Acrobatics or Thievery check to disable an oozeshardling results in the creature attempting the check taking 1d6 acid damage (2d6 acid on a critical failure).
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The oozeshardling uses its first action to make an electric spark Strike against one random non-ooze creature within range, its second action is used to move straight in a random cardinal direction (roll  to determine the direction), and its third action to make a second electric spark Strike against a different random non-ooze creature within range. The oozeshardling doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.
datos.reinicio: The oozeshardling node collapses and melds back into the oozeshard after 1 minute, or disappears entirely if the oozeshard is slain.

spectral-archers.descripcion: Ghostly soldiers wielding crossbows manifest within the towers that flank the gatehouse and rain bolts down upon intruders.

datos.desactivar: Intimidation DC 31 (expert) to cow the archers into fleeing or Religion DC 28 (expert) to temporarily banish the spirits
datos.reinicio: The haunt vanishes permanently if the graveknights are destroyed. Otherwise, it returns after 1 hour.

stinkface-surprise.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
stinkface-surprise.descripcion: A pile of excrement and rotten food is launched at whoever opens the trunk without first depressing a hidden button on the side of the trunk.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert) to unhook the launch spring

stranded-melody-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-16: Freedom for Wishes
stranded-melody-7-8.descripcion: Planar winds summoned from beyond sweep through the room, song and sound carried adrift on their current. This air elemental is trapped on the Material Plane and can't escape.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 27 (expert) twice to duplicate the melody and appease the elemental, or Arcana DC 30 (expert) and then Diplomacy DC 27 (trained) to guide the elemental through a planar tear elsewhere in the manor. Each attempt to Disable the hazard requires two actions, and each successful check to Disable removes one action from the hazard's routine.
datos.rutina: (2 actions) For each action in the routine, the melody makes a solid refrain Strike against one creature in its area. This trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.
datos.reinicio: The melody remains for 1 minute, after which it disperses into several holes in the walls. It returns after an hour unless disabled.

swatted-like-flies.descripcion:
Feeling the presence of creatures on its backside, the Granite Ox swishes its stone tail to swat them away.
Escaping The PCs overcome this hazard by moving out of the area that the Ox's tail can reach. A PC escapes (and is not subject to tail Strikes) by ascending the Ox's sloped back, traveling a distance based on the result of the PC's Reflex save from the Shaken Loose hazard. PCs can Climb up the Ox's back with a successful Athletics DC 24 check or—by finding and scrambling up improvised paths—a Acrobatics DC 26, Perception DC 26, or Survival DC 26 check. With a successful Acrobatics DC 20 check, a flying PC can ascend half their fly Speed (or their full Speed on a critical success). PCs can attempt to Disable the hazard whether or not they're in range of the tail.

datos.desactivar: Acrobatics DC 26 to scramble out of the way, Deception DC 24 or Intimidation DC 24 (trained) to draw the Ox's attention. The DC of the flat check for this round (see Routine) is increased by 4 on a success, or by 8 on a critical success. Increasing the flat check DC to 21 or higher buys the party enough time to move up the Ox's back, disabling the hazard.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The Granite Ox makes a tail Strike against one creature in the area. If the attack succeeds, the GM rolls a Flat DC 9. On a success, the hazard makes another Strike. The hazard continues making Strikes until the GM fails the flat check.
datos.reinicio: Once all of the PCs moved outside the tail's striking range, the hazard is effectively disabled. The hazard reactivates if any PC returns to that area.

temptation-of-glory.fuente: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea
temptation-of-glory.descripcion: Ghostly images of your heart's desire appear and beckon you toward them.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 25 or Religion DC 25 (expert) to disrupt the images; Occultism DC 26 (expert) to shout a countering chant; Intimidation DC 27 (expert) to scare the images away; Will DC 28 save (expert) to refuse to listen
datos.rutina:
(1 per PC) The hazard targets a PC and uses cruel temptation

—
Special The hazard continues each round until defeated, and the hallway's end cannot be reached until the hazard is stopped.

the-watching-lords.descripcion: The demigod statues in the alcoves seem to shift, their heads turning to watch as intruders pass by.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 31 (to scrape away hidden runes that grant the statues the ability to watch), Religion DC 28 (to pray for protection from the attention of Abyssal lords), or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the trap
datos.reinicio: Once the Watching Lords are triggered, the trap needs an hour to recharge its energies, after which point it can be triggered again.

thin-ice.descripcion: The white-and-blue ice is less structurally sound than it looks.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 31 or Survival DC 31 (expert) to spread out and prevent the ice from cracking further, or Acrobatics DC 31 or Athletics DC 31 (trained) to get off the ice safely as it cracks.
datos.reinicio: The river freezes over every night, restoring this hazard. The hazard disappears once the vernal equinox passes.

unwelcome-guests.descripcion: Unwelcome guests who touch this hatch are cursed.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 28 (expert) to drain the magic from the curse, Thievery DC 31 (master) to unweave the curse's bindings, or Dispel Magic (4th rank, counteract DC 28) to counteract the curse
datos.reinicio: The trap resets when the hatch is shut.

vile-brew.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
vile-brew.descripcion: The brewing equipment begins to shudder and shake, and thick foamy sludge starts to bubble up out of the various pipes, tuns, and barrels—sludge that contains blinking eyes, screaming mouths, and twitching fingers among its turbulent mass!

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 28 (master) to swiftly dismantle key parts of the contraption containing the vile brew, or Religion DC 31 (expert) to exorcise the haunt; three total successes in all are needed to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (3 actions) On its initiative, the churning awfulness extrudes a long, slimy tendril of clotted blood, tangled hair, and jagged broken teeth. These long, whiplike lengths then make three vile lash Strikes on three randomly determined targets in the room. With their reach and ability to manifest from any part of the machinery, these Strikes can target any creature in the room. They only target a creature more than once if there's not enough targets to split their attention.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates at the start of any round in which no living creatures are in the room; it then reactivates 1 minute later.

vision-of-dahak.descripcion: Blasts of fire and smoke pour out of the tunnel walls to coalesce into the burning form of Dahak himself; a PC who succeeds at a Religion DC 20 check to Recall Knowledge notes that the fiery dragon closely resembles classical depictions of the draconic god of destruction.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 26 (expert) to utter prayers to a non-evil deity to counteract Dahak's presence (prayers to Apsu allow this check to be made if the character is merely trained in Religion), Thievery DC 30 (expert) to divert the hazard's energies back upon themselves, or a successful Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26).
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The vision of Dahak manifests next to the creature that is closest to the center of the way station, then uses its Breath Weapon in a direction that catches the most possible targets in its area.
datos.reinicio: The vision of Dahak deactivates and resets automatically once no creatures remain within the Huntergate way station.

wrathful-dinosaur.descripcion: This figurine of a charging triceratops was crafted from the dinosaur's femur and contains its spirit.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 24 (expert) to banish the dinosaur's spirit with a primal incantation, Intimidation DC 28 to scare it off with a frightening display, or Survival DC 26 (expert) to calm the spirit
datos.reinicio: 1 day

abendego-s-squall-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-00: Salt of the Ocean
abendego-s-squall-7-8.descripcion: Abendego's Squall leaps from the water. Its mouth opens to snap against any part of the ship that it can reach.

datos.desactivar: Medicine DC 23 (expert) to remove the harpoon, Nature DC 23 (trained), or Intimidation DC 23 (expert) to scare the orca away; two total successes are required to subdue the orca
datos.rutina:
d The Abendego's Squall Leaps over the Snapdragon with each action. When it lands, it deals 4 damage to the Snapdragon. All creatures on the deck take 3d10+40 bludgeoning and must attempt a Reflex DC 28 save.

—
Critical Success The target is unaffected.
Success The target takes half damage.
Failure The target takes full damage and is Clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn.
Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is Clumsy 2 until the end of its next turn.

—
Speed 30 feet
datos.reinicio: The Abendego's Squall returns to hunt down the Snapdragon after 8 hours.

abyssal-firestorm-surge-9-10.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-24: Breaking The Storm: Parting Clouds
abyssal-firestorm-surge-9-10.descripcion: High winds and forest fires intensified by Abyssal energy batters everything in the surge's path.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 33, Nature DC 33, Occultism DC 33, or Religion DC 33 (trained) to redirect the storm surge or Dispel Magic (5th rank, counteract DC 26) to nullify it.

animated-fang.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-13: Ancient Beyond Imagining
animated-fang.descripcion: The fang on the altar leaps up to stab at insufficiently zealous creatures.

datos.desactivar: The haunt is disabled once there aren't any creatures in the room that haven't sufficiently proclaimed their zeal (as described above).
datos.rutina: (two-actions) The fang leaps around the room, flying up to 20 feet and making a fang Strike against a random creature in the room.
datos.reinicio: If the fang is not destroyed, it returns to the altar and the haunt resets immediately.

army-of-mist.descripcion: The wind intensifies and the seeping fog rushes forward in a stampede of ghostly orcs screaming wordless battle cries, weapons raised to slaughter their foes.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 28 (expert) to funnel the magic powering the mist back into itself, or Religion DC 30 (expert) to exorcise some of the trapped souls and weaken the storm; three total successes in any combination are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The army of mist uses 3 actions to make frozen fists Strikes against three random creatures, favoring non-orcs or anyone who attempted to Disable it within the past round.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area of Fort Whiteskull but resets immediately. The army of mist resets 1 day after being disabled if the ancestor storm isn't put to rest.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 30 or Occultism DC 30 (master) to soothe the psychic impressions or Thievery DC 28 (expert) to jam the door open
datos.reinicio: The trap resets automatically.

battle-illusion.descripcion: The scene of the arid Cinderlands melts away as the water of the river refills and green grass spreads across the land. The sounds of battle can be heard everywhere and all allies have vanished, murderous orcs from the One Eye Hold taking their place.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 30 or Religion DC 30 (expert) twice to weaken the haunt or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 27) to counteract the illusions
datos.rutina:
(1 action; illusion, incapacitation, mental, occult) The haunt continues the illusion, making victims feel as though they've been abandoned and are surrounded by attackers on all sides. Each creature in the haunt's area must make a Will DC 28 save.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute.
Success The creature is unaffected.
Failure The creature is Confused for 1 round.
Critical Failure The creature is hostile toward the supposed One Eye orcs and must spend all actions moving toward and attacking One Eye orcs. This hostility lasts for 1 minute, until the haunt is disabled, or until they fall Unconscious. They cannot voluntarily stop attacking those they perceive as enemies.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the Shadefields but resets immediately. The battle illusion resets 1 day after being disabled if the ancestor storm isn't put to rest.

benefactor-s-end.descripcion: A spectral assailant drives a stake into a dying vampire's heart; the vampire collapses and releases a surge of void energy.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 28 (expert) to drain away the haunt's void energy
datos.reinicio: Unless disabled, the haunt materializes again on the next moonrise.

bestial-transformation.descripcion: Enchanted carvings of animals transform any creatures who damage the door into the animal they harmed.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 26 (expert) to handle the animal carvings or Thievery DC 33 (master) to scratch out the animal carvings or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the spell
datos.reinicio: automatic

boulder-cage.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure: The Scourge of Sheerleaf
boulder-cage.descripcion: Several large boulders are separated by wooden support beams, entrapping a woman and three young children within.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) on the support beams to separate them enough to allow Mayor Eliana's family to escape without being crushed.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The trap uses its first action to slam a hanging stone into the main beam of the trap, and its last two actions to launch splinter Strikes against two Medium or smaller creatures. The main beam can withstand four rounds of this before splintering.

cannibalization-of-the-priestess.descripcion: Spectral undead converge on any living creatures to rip into and devour them.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 28 to push past or run away, or Occultism DC 28 or Religion DC 28 (expert) to exorcise the haunt
datos.rutina: (1 action) The haunt converges upon all creatures currently bleeding in area M2. The targeted creatures must attempt a basic Fortitude DC 28 save against 3d6 spirit,3d6 void damage from the spirits pulling and gnawing on their souls. On a critical failure, the creature also suffers 2d6 persistent damage.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after there are no bleeding creatures left in M2. If disabled, it resets after 1 day. Destroying Illcayna is the only way to permanently destroy this haunt.

caustic-gas-trap.descripcion: Pressure plates in the hall trigger the release of caustic gas.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 28 (master) to neutralize the acid or Thievery DC 30 (master) to disable the pressure plates
datos.reinicio: A 10-minute Interact activity and a new supply of caustic gas.

cleansing-torrent.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-14: The Tomb Between Worlds
cleansing-torrent.descripcion: The ritual power in this room, corrupted by necromantic energy, slams purifying water into all "unclean" creatures that try to leave.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 28 (expert) to ceremonially purify everyone in the room, by pouring water from a tub over their hands, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the corrupted ritual magic.
datos.reinicio: 1 minute

conference-z-s-victims.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-11: The Hidden Current
conference-z-s-victims.descripcion: The pain of over 300 souls crying out for recognition and revenge pierces through the room, as a spiritual whirlwind fills the space.

datos.desactivar: Medicine DC 30 or Society DC 30 to determine 287's first or surname through the journal text or Occultism DC 32 or Religion DC 32 to connect with the spiritual energy bound to the journal to find her name. Two successes are needed, one for each part of 287's name.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The haunt makes a howling wail Strike against all living creatures in area A13 as 1 action.
datos.reinicio: The haunt vanishes permanently if 287's name is revealed.

consuming-cabinet.descripcion: Animated cabinet imprisons intruders. The cabinet has two compartments; each can hold a single Medium creature or two Small-sized creatures or smaller.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (expert) twice on cabinet; Crafting DC 28 or Thievery DC 28 (expert) to remove each or two doors
datos.rutina:
(3 actions) The trap uses its first action to move directly toward the nearest living creature, its second action to make a door Strike against each adjacent creature, and its third action to Batter. This trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.

—

Speed 15 feet
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 hour.

conundrum-ward.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
conundrum-ward.descripcion: A complex geometrical ward with mathematical equations woven into its lines magically seals the door, harming anyone who touches it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (master) to sabotage the ward, Geometry or Mathematics-lore DC 25 (trained) to calculate the solution to the complex equations, Crafting DC 28 (expert) to manipulate the ward's precise underlying schematics, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the magical ward
datos.reinicio: The trap automatically resets after being triggered. If disabled, the ward does not reset.

divine-oozeshardling-node.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-07: A God Falls Where Magic Fails
divine-oozeshardling-node.descripcion: A lump of bluish ooze shot through with what look like tiny silver shavings of metal. Once it has been activated, it glows with arcs of electricity that leap out at nearby targets.

datos.desactivar: Two successful Arcana DC 25 or Occultism DC 25 (trained) checks on the oozeshardling to disperse its power, or Acrobatics DC 27 or Thievery DC 27 (expert) to remove the flecks of empowering warshard from within the oozeshardling. A failed Acrobatics or Thievery check to disable an oozeshardling results in the creature attempting the check taking 1d6 acid damage (2d6 acid on a critical failure).
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The oozeshardling uses its first action to make an electric spark Strike against one random non-ooze creature within range, its second action is used to move straight in a random cardinal direction (roll  to determine the direction), and its third action to make a second electric spark Strike against a different random non-ooze creature within range. The oozeshardling doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.
datos.reinicio: The oozeshardling node collapses and melds back into the oozeshard after 1 minute, or disappears entirely if the oozeshard is slain.

drandlesticks-9-10.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-22: Breaking the Storm: Excising Ruination
drandlesticks-9-10.descripcion: Enchanted caltrops blend in with the surrounding masonry.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 to safely clear the path.

electrified-hall.descripcion: Runes hidden in the door's carvings blast lightning down the hall.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (master) to scratch out the runes, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the runes
datos.reinicio: automatic

enraged-polar-bear-spirit.descripcion: The ghostly spirit of a polar bear stands on its hind legs and roars.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 26 (expert) to calm the spirit, Intimidation DC 30 (master) to cow the spirit, or Religion DC 30 (expert) to contain the spiritual corruption (each successful check reduces its number of actions by 1)
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The bear moves around the room at an alarming speed, seemingly teleporting, and Strikes a random creature with its spiritual claws.
datos.reinicio: The bear spirit calms after no creatures are in the room for 1 minute but is ready to lash out again after 10 minutes.

etward-s-nightmare.descripcion: The incense burners begin to smoke, filling the air with strangely nostalgic scents.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 26 (expert) to enter a state akin to lucid dreaming so as to unweave the nightmare from within, or Intimidation DC 30 (master) to stand resolute against the nightmares and turn the fear back upon itself
datos.rutina:
(2 actions; cold, mental, occult) The haunt uses its first action to light incense burners again, forcing any creature that isn't already Unconscious to save against that effect once more. Its second action is to cause any unconscious creatures in the room to experience horrific, vivid dreams about being lost in the arctic during a blizzard, while enormous furred figures— saumen kar—lunge at them through the snow to attack repeatedly. Each unconscious creature must attempt a Fortitude DC 28 saving throw. If at the end of the round there are no unconscious creatures in the room, Etward's nightmare ends and the trap deactivates.

—
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and wakes up.
Success The creature remains unconscious and takes 1d10 cold,1d10 mental. This damage does not wake the creature, and those who are awake can see the unconscious creature thrash as if in the throes of a nightmare while their body rimes over with layers of frost. The creature can fight against the bitter cold and monstrous shapes by attempting a Will DC 28 save as a three-action activity on its turn— on a success, the creature wakes up.
Failure As success, but 1d10+6 cold,1d10+6 mental, and with a Will DC 32 save to wake up.
Critical Failure The creature remains unconscious and takes 2d10+12 cold,2d10+12 mental.
datos.reinicio: The hazard resets when Etward dreams in this room.

exhaling-portal.descripcion: Magic runes carved into a doorframe connect a door to the Plane of Air when opened, blowing creatures down the connecting hall.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (expert) twice to scratch out the runes, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 30) to counteract the planar runes; Athletics DC 32 to shut the door if it's open (using Athletics only stops the trap, it doesn't fully disable it)
datos.rutina: (1 action) The trap uses 1 action to blow powerful winds down the hall. Each creature in the hall must attempt a Fortitude DC 32 save with the same results as Gust. If this forced movement would cause a creature to collide with a solid object or fall downstairs or out a window, that creature takes an additional 2d10 + 11 bludgeoning damage (or 20 bludgeoning damage due to a fall).
datos.reinicio: The trap resets when the door is shut.

explosive-entrance.descripcion: An alchemical bombs explodes when the rubble is shifted, filling the hall with flame.
