datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 30 (master) to nullify the bomb's alchemical components or Thievery DC 28 (master) to disable the bomb

extremely-helpful-wisp-swarm.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-13: Thick as Thieves
extremely-helpful-wisp-swarm.descripcion: Hovering amid the branches of an acacia tree, a swarm of wood wisps attempt to gather the papers that have been caught in its leaves and thorns.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy Diplomacy DC 23 (trained) to make a Request, Athletics DC 23 (trained) to climb the tree and help gather papers manually, or Performance DC 25 (trained) to demonstrate how the wisps can help without destroying the papers.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The wisp swarm loses one action for each successful check to disable it. The wisps swarm to work on each of their actions, making a headbutt Strike against any creature within 10 feet of the tree and destroying 2d4 pages of notes.

falling-decorations.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-15: Within Antiquated Halls
falling-decorations.descripcion: Large metal moons and spears break apart and fall when a creature moves beneath them.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) or Crafting DC 28 (expert) to prevent the decorations from falling.

fear-of-the-devil.descripcion: A smoke and fire manifestation of the Sandpoint Devil emerges from the pit with a blast of foul-smelling smoke.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 30 (master) to soothe and calm the unquiet fears left behind by the slain adventurers or Religion DC 30 (master) to hinder the haunt with prayers of protection (two successes from either skill disables the haunt)
datos.rutina: (1 action; evocation, fire, occult) The smoking vision of the Sandpoint Devil appears to hover over the pit, its wings of fire flapping as its head lowers to exhale a 30-foot cone of fire into the room, targeting as many creatures as possible. Note that the geist can be targeted by this blast of fire as well, but remember that its resistance applies to the fire. All creatures in the area take 7d6 fire damage (basic Reflex DC 28 save). A creature that critically fails this saving throw is also Frightened 1; this effect has the emotion, fear, and mental traits.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

flensing-bone-pillars.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
flensing-bone-pillars.descripcion: Eight pillars composed of jagged bones spin, damaging anyone adjacent who doesn't worship Zon-Kuthon.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 22 to disassemble one pillar, Religion DC 22 to ritually purify one pillar, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26) once to counteract the magic binding all the bone pillars together, deactivating the whole trap
datos.rutina: (8 actions) Each of the functioning bone pillars makes a bone spur Strike against an adjacent creature. This trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty. This trap loses one action for each disabled or destroyed pillar.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute. The trap is automatically destroyed if all the velstracs on this floor are killed.

flinging-tools.descripcion: Animated awls, hammers, nails, and other tools hurl themselves off the tool bench at intruders.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 33 (master) to soothe the psychic echoes, Religion DC 32 (expert) to overwhelm the area's energy, or Occultism DC 32 (expert) to counter the psychic echoes; on the third successful check, the psychic echoes are disrupted, and the trap is destroyed.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The trap launches one tool against every living creature within 15 feet as 1 action. Because it flings tools continuously, the trap can also use the Continuous Barrage free action to fling tools at each creature during that creature's turn.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 hour.

flooding-room.descripcion: When the western secret door is opened or any of the trapdoors in the ceiling are forced open, the trap is triggered. As soon as this occurs, the portcullises to the east and west come crashing down, each consisting of solid iron sheets that form watertight seals. At the same time, the dozen 5-foot-wide trapdoors open in the ceiling. These holes are the mouths of winding tunnels that connect to a second pair of apertures on the submerged side of the island outside, allowing the waters of the Little Sellen River to plunge down into this room, possibly damaging or knocking Prone those in the square portion of the room itself (but not in the adjoining hallway) and eventually flooding the entire chamber.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (this increases to Thievery DC 30 once the trap is activated) to disable one of the 12 trapdoors and seal it shut; disabling all 12 of the trapdoors completely deactivates the trap, but a critical failure on any attempt causes the trap to trigger; Thievery DC 24 to disable one of the watertight portcullises and prevent it from falling; magic such as shape stone or wall of stone or even lock can also be used to disable portions of this deadly trap at the GM's discretion
datos.rutina:
(12 actions) The trap loses 1 action for each of its 12 ceiling trapdoors that are disabled. On each of the trap's actions, it pours water into the room, filling it to a depth of one inch. If all 12 trapdoors are open, it thus fills the room at a rate of 1 foot per round. If one of the portcullises is breached, the trap fills the room at half the rate, and if both are breached, it fills at one quarter the rate. Once the cascade of water begins, it's easy enough for a PC to avoid the downpour, but any creature that deliberately enters the cascade is subjected to the trap's Rushing Water reaction. If a creature is struck by Rushing Water while already underwater, the result of its Reflex save is automatically improved one degree of success.

The flooding ends and the trap deactivates once the area is filled to the ceiling-at this point, the water's surface is at the level of the river, and at the top of the stairs leading down from areas D4 and D6. A Medium or smaller creature can try to Swim to freedom through one of the 5-foot-wide tunnels leading to the river from a trapdoor, but doing so requires navigating 200 feet of flooded tunnels.
datos.reinicio: The trap must be reset with a major engineering effort.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (master) to painstakingly remove the rune without triggering the magic, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the rune.

in-the-witch-s-clutches.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-11: Prisoners of the Electric Castle
in-the-witch-s-clutches.descripcion: Spectral hag claws reach out from the walls of the gem-like chamber to grab the PCs' souls and pull them into the trap's onyx facets.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) or Crafting DC 28(expert) to find the weak spot and crack each facet, or dispel magic (5th level; counteract DC 26) to counteract each facet; the hazard has a number of facets equal to the number of PCs.
datos.rutina:
The hazard gains a number of actions equal to the number of PCs; it loses 1 action each round for each facet that has been disabled. Each claw tears at a different PC, who takes 2d10+13 mental damage (basic Will DC 30 save). On a failure, they are Grabbed by the claw (). On a critical failure, or on a failure if they are already grabbed, they have their soul ripped from their body, which falls Unconscious. Each round on their turn, the soul can attempt a Intimidation DC 28, Occultism DC 28, or Survival DC 28 check to fortify itself and return to its body as a three-action activity. The possible outcomes are as follows.

—

Critical Success The soul returns to their body, which loses the unconscious condition.

Success The soul returns to their body, which loses the unconscious condition, but gains the grabbed condition.

Failure The soul makes no progress toward escape.

Critical Failure The soul makes no progress toward escape and the target takes 2d10+13 mental damage until they are reduced to 0 Hit Points, after which they remain in captivity until the trap is defeated.

—

Each claw focuses on its target until the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points, after which it takes no action on its turn unless another facet is disabled or its target regains Hit Points.

insolent-s-castigation.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-14: The Tomb Between Worlds
insolent-s-castigation.descripcion: Pressure plates trigger hidden mauls in the walls of the pits that swing up to slam creatures and knock them off the span.

datos.desactivar: Society DC 30 (expert) to locate the hidden deactivation switch or Thievery DC 33 (expert) to jam the mechanics on the span.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets over the course of the round and is ready to swing again 1 round later. It can be manually reset if Disabled.

iomedae-s-flame.descripcion: A magical flame changes color in response to Fort Ozem's alert status, with a 10-foot radius.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 30, Nature DC 30, Occultism DC 30, or Religion DC 30 (expert) to snuff out the flame with opposing magic; each success reduces the flame's color one step (from red to blue, blue to yellow, and so on). A critical success reduces the flame's color two steps. A success while the flame is white permanently disables the hazard.
datos.reinicio: The hazard resets automatically each round. After 1 hour, the flame reverts to its default status of a white flame.

major-fireball-rune.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-09: Killer in the Golden Mask
major-fireball-rune.descripcion: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 20-foot radius.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the rune

maze-of-mirrors.fuente: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God
maze-of-mirrors.descripcion: Invisible runes in the maze disorient those within it and cause its mirrored walls to shift about.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 26 (expert) or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to stop the mirrors' shuffling; Occultism DC 28 or Religion DC 28 (expert) to dispel the minotaur
datos.rutina:
(3 actions) The trap uses its first action to magically shuffle the mirrors, rendering markings or maps of the maze ineffective. Creatures in the maze that fail a Will DC 26 save are Stupefied 1 until they leave the maze. If the target fails additional saves against this ability, the condition value increases by 1 (to a maximum of stupefied 4).
For its second action, the trap's ghostly minotaur attacks a random creature in the maze with its spectral gore.
For its third action, the trap makes another spectral gore attack against a random creature.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without any creature in the maze.

memory-hole.descripcion: Anyone looking into the hole has memories sucked from their head.

datos.desactivar: Deception DC 29 (master) to feed the pit false thoughts that plug it, or Occultism DC 28 (expert) or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 27) to drain the pit's magic
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 1 hour if it's not disabled.

mournful-petals-haunt.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
mournful-petals-haunt.descripcion: A flurry of scattered flower petals flies through the area, as psychic impressions of pain, sorrow, and being trapped assail the living—Mirida's scattered memories.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 31 or Religion DC 31 (expert) to weaken the haunt, Deception DC 29 or Diplomacy DC 29 (expert) to soothe the haunt's sorrow; three total successes in any combination are required to disable the haunt.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The flower petals surge through the room, dealing 2d10+13 slashing damage to all creatures in the area (basic Reflex DC 32 save). A creature that fails is additionally Frightened 2 (Frightened 4 on a critical failure).
datos.reinicio: The petals disperse after 1 minute and reset after 1 day.

natron-explosion.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-14: The Tomb Between Worlds
natron-explosion.descripcion: Negative-energy charged natron sprays out of the tub and starts to mummify nearby creatures.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (expert) to safely remove the umbral vise from the tub without triggering the natron or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the ritual energy.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 24 hours.

no-light-shall-guide-thee.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
no-light-shall-guide-thee.descripcion: The evercursed crystals suddenly extinguish if they are disturbed, taking the PCs' sight away with their failing light.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (master) to subtly sift the ashes aside in a way where the curse simply fades without discerning a target or Occultism DC 33 (expert) to know how to harmlessly disperse the malign magic

occult-weather.descripcion: The sky suddenly darkens with storm clouds rumbling overhead, the faces of the dead forming in the clouds above as their voices wail along the high winds.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 28 (expert) to funnel the magic powering the weather back into itself, or Religion DC 30 (expert) to exorcise some of the trapped souls and weaken the storm; three total successes in any combination are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The occult weather intensifies, with winds picking up speed and lightning and thunder sounding overhead. The occult weather uses 3 actions to make lightning Strikes against three random creatures, favoring orcs or anyone who attempted to Disable it within the past round, then uses Wind of Screams as its final action.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the Shadefields but resets immediately. The occult weather resets 1 day after being disabled if the ancestor storm isn't put to rest.

overloading-arch-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
overloading-arch-7-8.descripcion: The Eternity Arch sparks with electricity, releasing bolts of lightning at each of the four largest time rifts.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (expert) or Arcana DC 28, Nature DC 28, Occultism DC 28, or Religion DC 28 (expert) to seal each of the four time rifts, Crafting DC 30 (trained) to divert the lightning to another source, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract each time rift.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each disabled time rift. On each of the trap's actions, the Eternity Arch releases a bolt of lightning that activates that rift, dealing 2d12 electricity damage to all creatures in a 10-foot emanation around the time rift (basic Reflex DC 28 save). It can release a bolt at each active time rift no more than once each turn.

puncturing-spires.descripcion: A metal spire bursts from the ground, skewering the target and knocking aside other creatures.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 30 or Occultism DC 30 (expert) to seal the planar breach, or Nature DC 28 (master) to magically reinforce the ground and prevent a spire's emergence.

quarry-sluiceway.descripcion: Six sluice gates open to allow thousands of gallons of water to begin flooding the room. The water churns through the room and flows out through three chutes on the south end of the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) twice to close a sluice (on a critical success, a sluice is closed immediately)
datos.rutina:
(6 actions) The trap loses 1 action per disabled or destroyed sluice. On each of its actions, the water rushing from the sluices flows through the room, creating a river of churning water that fills the room to several inches and makes the floor of the chamber into difficult terrain. The water level never rises above this level in the room, as it drains out of the chutes to the south and begins to flood the quarry pit (area J2). On the trap's second turn, the water starts filling the four slave pits in area J2. Each of the trap's actions fills the pits 4 inches (2 feet per round if all sluices are functional). If the slave pits fill to their total depth of 12 feet and the grates over the slave pits aren't open, the slaves begin to drown, dying if they aren't freed in 5 rounds. Once the slave pits are full, the water continues to slowly fill the central area over the course of an hour until it empties the reservoir and floods area J2 to a depth of 15 feet.

Other options beyond disabling or destroying the sluices could prevent the flooding of the quarry pit at your discretion.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets if all six sluices are closed. If all the water has drained when this occurs, the water takes many months to refill.

repelling-surge.descripcion: A shockwave of energy surges out from the room's center.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 29 (expert) to fool the wards, Thievery DC 31 (master) to disable the wards, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the wards
datos.reinicio: Automatic

sargassum-bud-pile.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-17: The Devil in the Details
sargassum-bud-pile.descripcion: Sargassum heaps that have only started to grow have no intelligence, but are incredibly tenacious and can reflexively grab onto nearby prey. They obtain nutrients by drowning prey in the water they grow in.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 32 (expert) to rip the reflexive tendrils off the bud or Thievery DC 32 (expert) to trigger the tendrils beforehand and keep them occupied.
datos.reinicio: 1 hour if the bud pile has something in its grasps. 1 round if the bud pile has nothing in its grasps.

scalding-tar-lake.descripcion: The bubbling tar churns and seethes, periodically bursting in a burning hot splatter of scalding sludge and gas.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 30 check to throw rocks or other bits of debris into areas within the tar lake that are about to burst, allowing the lake to vent harmlessly for that round (on a critical success, this prevents the lake from venting for 3 rounds); permanently disabling the tar pit would require powerful magic or long-term engineering projects (subject to the GM's discretion).
datos.rutina: (1 action) The bubbling lake of tar churns and sputters. One randomly determined target within 5 feet of the tar lake is targeted by a Scalding Burst.

scroll-shock-trap.descripcion: Five scroll symbols shoot electricity bolts around the room.

datos.desactivar:
Thievery DC 25 (expert) or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 24)

Thievery DC 29 (master) to disable the entire trap from the hidden control panel beneath the central slab.
datos.rutina:
(5 actions) Each disabled symbol reduces the trap's number of actions by 1.

For each of its actions, a different symbol shoots an electricity bolt at a random creature in the room. The trap doesn't take multiple attack penalties.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates 1 round after it has no target creatures and resets after 1 minute.

shadow-heart.descripcion: A heart of tumorous, shadowy tissue unleashes magic on nearby creatures.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 26 or Occultism DC 26 (expert) to counter the heart's offensive magic, or Religion DC 28 (trained) to purify the area containing the heart. Four successes are required to disable it; after two successes, the shadow heart can't use its shadow lash Strike.
datos.rutina: The shadow heart uses Battering Vortex, and then uses shadow lash on a random creature within range.
datos.reinicio: The heart deactivates if there are no creatures present in the room. It resets in 1 hour.

shadow-spears-9-10.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-19: Mean Streets of Shadow Absalom
shadow-spears-9-10.descripcion: Invisible runes are concealed within an elaborate light-woven floor mosaic.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (trained) to remove pieces from the mosaic without triggering the magic or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the rune

shattering-rune.descripcion: A magical rune is inscribed on the tarry earth at the entrance to the hut, buried beneath snow, with an Invisible sensor that detects creatures within a 10-foot-radius sphere.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (master) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to dispel the rune

silvered-retribution.fuente: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
silvered-retribution.descripcion: Pressure plates in the floor, wall, and ceiling of this hall trigger silver blades to protrude from the ceiling, slashing anything passing through the hall.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (master) to disable the pressure plates; two successes are required to disable the trap
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The maze of blades continues to spin, jab, and slash, dealing 2d10+13 slashing damage (magic, silver) to all creatures in the area (basic Reflex DC 28 save).
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates after 1 minute and can be manually reset.

soul-ripper.descripcion: Two hosts of shadowy spirits emerge from Hell to rip Oourax's soul in two, damaging all those who stand in their path.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 33 or Deception DC 33 to convince the spirits to ignore you, or Occultism DC 30 or Religion DC 30 to weaken the haunt; four successes are required to disable it. After 5 rounds, Oourax's soul is sundered and the haunt ends.
datos.rutina: (1 action) Oourax's soul attempts to flee, moving 20 feet in a random direction. Her soul is pursued by two hosts of devilish spirits. Large or smaller creatures (or troops composed of Large or smaller creatures) within a 20-foot emanation of Oourax's soul are trampled by the spirits (2d10+13 spirit damage with a basic Reflex DC 28 save).

spirit-cyclone.descripcion: A cyclone of angry spirits surges around the area.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 30 (trained) or Religion DC 30 (trained) to weaken the haunt; three total successes in any combination are required to disable the haunt
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The spirit cyclone uses 3 actions to move, traveling up to 30 feet with each action and dealing 2d10+13 void damage to each creature in its path (basic Reflex DC 32 save). A creature needs to attempt only one save during the cyclone's movement, even if the cyclone moves over its space more than once. On a critical failure, a creature is swept up into the cyclone, becoming Grabbed (). A creature grabbed by the cyclone moves along with the cyclone and takes 1d10+6 void damage at their beginning of its turn, and it must attempt a Reflex save against the cyclone on the cyclone's turn, no matter where the cyclone moves. A creature that successfully Escapes from the cyclone falls from a height of 1d12 x 5 feet.
datos.reinicio: The spirit cyclone disperses after 1 minute and resets after 1 day.

springloaded-statues.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-20: The Rakshasa's Court
springloaded-statues.descripcion: Four animal statues sit on pillars, one in each corner of the statuary, with decorated tiles between them in a seemingly random arrangement.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 28 (expert) or Stealth DC 31 (expert) to disarm the statue while adjacent to it
datos.reinicio: Each statue resets immediately after being triggered.

steaming-fields-7-8.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-24: Lightning Strikes, Stars Fall
steaming-fields-7-8.descripcion: A field of warm mist covers an open plain. Pockets of highly pressurized steam lie Hidden in the earth; pressure releases jets of steam.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 30 (expert) twice to navigate a safe path

tar-pit.descripcion: A 15-foot-wide patch of tar covered with dirt and leaves attempts to capture creatures that step onto it.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 25 (expert) to disturb the surface and reveal the tar pit
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its initiative, the tar pit pulls down each creature within it, thick tar adhering to the creature's body. A creature that was submerged up to its waist becomes submerged up to its neck, and a creature that was submerged up to its neck is pulled under and must hold its breath to avoid suffocation. A creature in the tar pit can attempt a Athletics DC 33 check to Climb to either raise itself by one step (if it's submerged to its neck or full submerged) or to move 5 feet if it's submerged only up to its waist. On a critical failure, the creature is pulled down one step. Other creatures can Aid the creature, typically by using a rope or similar aid or by attempting to pull the creature out with their own Athletics DC 33 check, with the same results as if the creature attempted the check. In addition to the usual results, a character adjacent to the tar pit who critically fails while Aiding moves into the tar pit. A creature that Climbs out of the tar pit escapes the hazard and lands Prone in an adjacent space.
datos.reinicio: Though the hazard still captures anyone who touches it, the surface doesn't become hidden again until it settles, which takes 24 hours.

tempestuous-koi-egg.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-11: The Godsrain and the Dragon
tempestuous-koi-egg.descripcion: A raging storm covers the mountain lake as spring water levitates from the lake to fall back down in a driving spiral of steaming rain. In the depths of the storm, barely visible, is a tiny koi egg surrounded by three bands of water.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 29, Religion DC 29, Nature DC 29, or Occultism DC 29 to purify the magic corrupting the ascension ritual, or Diplomacy DC 32 or Performance DC 32 to soothe the spirit within the koi egg and give it the strength to fight off the corruption itself; four total successes are required to purify the ritual, each of the first three successes purifying one ring of water and the final one halting the ritual itself. If the cursed comb has not been removed from the ritual site, then succeeding on this final check merely halts the ritual; if the cursed comb has been removed from the ritual site, then succeeding on this final check completes the ascension ritual.
datos.rutina: (1 action) Torrential water descends from the sky, taking the shape of a dragon that smashes into one creature within 60 feet of the egg. The dragon always targets the creature that is closest to the egg, dealing 2d12 bludgeoning damage and 2d12 fire damage in a spray of boiling water (Fortitude DC 28 save). Creatures that fail the save are pushed 10 feet away. Creatures that have the earth trait, are carrying an item with the earth trait, or are otherwise strongly tied to elemental earth (such as an earth elemental sorcerer or kineticist) get the result one degree of success better than the outcome of their save, as the power of elemental earth overcomes water.
datos.reinicio: The turbulent koi egg can attempt to hatch again, restarting the ascension ritual, after 1000 years of Xalreonshin's care.

the-bastard-s-portrait.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
the-bastard-s-portrait.descripcion: A mysterious portrait lies face down on the floor.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 31 (trained) to carefully dismantle the portrait without jostling it enough to trigger it or Religion DC 33 (expert) to exorcise the haunt; 3 successes are required to disable it.

the-fight.descripcion: Nearby creatures are caught in the memory of the struggle between Iron Taviah and the Benefactor.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 28 or Religion DC 28 (expert) in the room to drain away the haunt's spiritual energy. Each successful check reduces the number of actions in the haunt's routine; three successful checks are required to completely disable the haunt.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The spectral Taviah uses 1 action to appear adjacent to a random creature within 30 feet if not already adjacent to a creature. It then uses its spectral claw Strike with its remaining actions.
datos.reinicio: Unless completely disabled or destroyed, the haunt resets at the next moonrise at full strength.

the-flight.descripcion: The spectral figure of a handsome, well-dressed man flees down the stairs, clutching a wound in his side with one hand and making a shoving motion with the other. His shout drives creatures back.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 30 or Religion DC 30 (expert) to drain away the haunt's spiritual energy. This check can be attempted only from the top of the stairs behind the secret door.
datos.rutina: (1 action) (divine, evocation, incapacitation, sonic) The spectral figure shouts, dealing 4d10 sonic damage to all creatures within 60 feet of the secret door (basic Will DC 28). A creature that fails its save is also Paralyzed for 1 round.
datos.reinicio: The haunt ends as soon as there are no creatures within 60 feet. It resets when the secret door is closed.

trampling-livestock.descripcion: Several ghostly mammoths arise from the floorboards, pawing at the ground in terror before stampeding toward the door.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 28 to exorcise the animals' spirits, or Nature DC 26 or Stabling-lore DC 24 to soothe them
datos.reinicio: 1 day

umbra-s-rage.descripcion: The anger of the fallen Umbra Legion seeps into any creature entering combat.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 26 (expert) to exorcise the closest spirits or Diplomacy DC 30 (expert) to calm them down

unbreakable-sorrow.descripcion: The PCs hear the sound of sobbing and feel an overwhelming sense of sorrow, as if they'd lost something more precious to them than their own life.

datos.desactivar: Deception DC 32 or Performance DC 32 (master) to laugh away the sadness, Occultism DC 31 (expert) to banish the psychic imprint, Thievery DC 33 (master) to disperse the emotional energy
datos.reinicio: The trap resets automatically after 24 hours.

vault-drowned-souls.descripcion: The spirits of the island's citizens manifest and panic as the vault fills with seawater.

datos.desactivar: DC 33 Athletics (trained) twice to  the vault's door or Religion DC 30 (trained) three times to exorcise the spirits
datos.rutina:
(1 action) Water begins to fill the vault from a crack in the floor hidden beneath the bones. The spirits of the citizens panic and grasp at the living, begging them to act. Each creature in the vault takes 2d10+13 void damage with a basic Fortitude DC 28 saving throw. On a failure, the creature is also Enfeebled 1 (or Enfeebled 2 on a critical failure).
The first time the hazard takes this action, water fills the vault to knee-height, making the area difficult terrain. The second time the hazard takes this action, the vault fills halfway with water, and creatures inside must succeed at a DC 15 Athletics check each round to . The third time the hazard takes this action, the vault fills entirely with water, and creatures inside must hold their breath.
datos.reinicio: The waters recede and the spirits disappear once no living creatures remain inside the vault, but the haunt resets immediately, triggering again if a living creature steps inside.

velicarn-s-head-haunt.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
velicarn-s-head-haunt.descripcion: A hideous mound of flesh, shattered bone, tangles of hair, and what appears to be gray matter lies in a glistening, 2-foot-tall heap on the floor, only to suddenly start piling up on itself to gradually form an immense, hateful head.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 30 (expert) to exorcise the haunt; three successes area required to disable it
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its turn, Velicarn's head continues to grow and expand as it becomes a monstrous distortion of his once-human appearance, with beady red eyes, sharp fangs, and two bat-like wings that unfurl from either side. The haunt screeches louder, and all creatures in the library take 4d6 persistent damage as blood pours from their ears, eyes, and mouths (basic Fortitude DC 28 save). If Velicarn's head isn't disabled or destroyed by the end of the third round, it rips out of the ground and joins the fight as a horrific monstrosity—a daqqanoenyent. At this point, the haunt is automatically disabled, and the PCs must face this new threat. As a daqqanoenyent, Velicarn's head focuses its attacks on the PCs and ignores the sahkil (who, if still alive, titters and cackles in delight at this development). It pursues PCs relentlessly and fights until it's destroyed, which permanently destroys the hazard.
datos.reinicio: Velicarn's head collapses back into a 2-foot-high mound of gore at the end of any round in which no non-fiend living creatures are in the library. It then resets 1 minute later.

waking-terror.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-17: Dreams of a Dustbound Isle
waking-terror.descripcion: Faceless statues struggle against each other to stay above the black dust.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 27 (expert) to urge the statues to work together, Intimidation DC 30 (expert) to Coerce the statues away, or Occultism DC 33 (trained) to oppose the psychic influence. Each check to disable the haunt is a two-action activity; three total successes are required to disable the haunt.
datos.rutina: (1 action) On the haunt's initiative, creatures in the area sink deeper into the dust as statues grasp at them. Creatures in the area take 2d10+13 mental damage (basic Will DC 28 saving throw). On a critical failure, the creature is also Confused for 1 round. Creatures Grabbed by the haunt take a -1 circumstance penalty to their saving throw.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.

ash-web.fuente: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City
ash-web.descripcion: This dangerous sooty black mold readily releases its toxic spores when disturbed. The entire swath of fungus in area B2 is a single organism. There are nine 10-foot-square patches to remove, but the whole organism dies once it takes enough damage.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 27 (expert) to remove a 10-foot-square patch of ash web without triggering the spores
datos.reinicio: This large patch of ash web resets automatically at the start of the round.

blast-tumbler.descripcion: A hard-to-reach rune is placed on the lock's tumbler. It emits a blast of force when the door is jostled.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 32 (master) to disarm the rune, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the rune's magic.
datos.reinicio: The rune resets 1 minute after it triggers.

blood-tears.descripcion: A wailing spirit appears and gouges their own eyes. As they do, blood seeps from the eyes of those who witness the act, obscuring their vision.

datos.desactivar: Diplomacy DC 30 (master) to talk the spirit out of gouging its eyes or Religion DC 32 (trained) to ease the spirit's sorrows
datos.reinicio: 1 day

by-the-horns.descripcion: The head of the Granite Ox tosses back and forth as the creature charges toward Dhuraxilis.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 27 (master) to tug one of the ox's ears, Arcana DC 32, Nature DC 32, Occultism DC 32, or Religion DC 32 (expert) to distract the Ox with a display of magic, or Acrobatics DC 35 (expert) to dangle in front of the Ox's eyes and obscure its vision; three successes are required to disable the hazard
datos.rutina: (1 action) The Granite Ox bucks. Each creature on the Ox's head must attempt a Reflex DC 33 save. Prone creatures gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the save. On a failure, the creature falls Prone. On a critical failure, the creature flies from the Ox's back, falling 120 feet to the ground or into Kardaji Bay.
datos.reinicio: The hazard ends automatically after 5 rounds or once all PCs are thrown from the Ox's back, whichever comes first.

calibrated-nahyndrian-focus.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-17: The Devil in the Details
calibrated-nahyndrian-focus.descripcion: A metal lattice forged from warshards feeds into a dark purplish crystal that pulses with energy. If the configuration of the lattice changes, so does the energy the device emits.

datos.desactivar: Three  (see Disabling the Focus under Event 1 on page 18).
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The Nahyndrian Focus uses Select Condition to determine which condition it is going to inflict. It then uses Inflict twice, usually on two different targets. If the focus is broken, it is Slowed 1, and can only Inflict once per turn.

collapsing-cliff-stairs.descripcion: The stairs' supports are rigged to collapse if the trip wires are triggered, sending a 10-foot section of stairs tumbling down the cliff.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 25 or Engineering Lore to shore up the supports, Perception DC 27 to notice the Hidden bypass lever in the stair railing, or Thievery DC 29 to disrupt the connecting mechanism

collapsing-lift.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
collapsing-lift.descripcion: The anchor points in the platform's corners suddenly tear loose, causing the entire platform to collapse into the shaft below.

datos.desactivar: Crafting DC 32 (expert) or Thievery DC 35 (expert) to reinforce one of the anchor points; at least three of the four dangerous anchor points must be disabled to make the lift safe

corazal-aflame.descripcion: Fire burns Corazal and threatens to spread to the surrounding forest.

datos.desactivar: Nature DC 30 or Survival DC 30 (expert) to douse flames or Athletics DC 32 (expert) to smother flames; on the sixth successful check, the flames go out. Casting a non-cantrip water spell on the flames counts as one success.
datos.rutina: (1 action; fire) On its turn, the fire deals 2d8+13 fire damage to creatures in the grove, plus an additional 6 fire damage to Corazal and any creature within 15 feet of them (basic Reflex DC 29 save).

daemonic-fog.descripcion: The fog solidifies into tiny, gnawing creatures that devour everyone within before fading back into mist.

datos.desactivar: Survival DC 28 (expert) to disrupt the fog before the hazard triggers or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 26) to counteract the magic.
datos.reinicio: The hazard resets over the course of an hour as the daemonic stain reenergizes the fog.

ekriathe-s-rage.descripcion: Ekriathe's talon releases a pulse of psychic rage throughout the area, transforming the lighthouse's lantern room into a pitched battlefield.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 27 (expert) twice to disrupt the divine mythic energies, or Thievery DC 32 (expert) twice to cut down the talon and remove it from the room without triggering the haunt
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The haunt attacks creatures in the area, making spear and talon Strikes against targets determined at random. The haunt takes the multiple attack penalty only if it targets the same creature more than once on a turn. The haunt loses one action if its Hit Points are reduced below its Break Threshold.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates once no creatures remain in the lantern room, but it resets immediately.

enhanced-fireball-rune.descripcion: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 20-foot radius.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 32 (expert) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 27) to counteract the rune

full-head-of-steam.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-20: The Rakshasa's Court
full-head-of-steam.descripcion: Hidden vents emit scalding hot steam made from a particularly acrid solution, irritating the eyes and throat of anyone who inhales it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 33 (expert) to block a vent, or Crafting DC 31 (expert) to disable the heating element within the vent that turns the liquid into steam
datos.rutina: (4 actions) Each of the four steam vents uses a single action each to emit superheated steam, which spreads for 60 feet along the wall from its location and extends out from the wall by 30 feet, dealing 2d12+13 untyped damage to each creature in their range (Fortitude DC 29 save). For each disabled vent, the trap loses 1 action each turn.
datos.reinicio: The steam vents cease to operate 1 minute after all creatures have left the area and go into a maintenance cycle for 1 hour. After this time, they can be triggered again.

hall-of-fiery-doom.descripcion: While the roof is on fire and collapsing timbers crush those within the hall, demons fly down from the sky to pluck victims from the flames.

datos.desactivar: Two Athletics DC 32 or Diplomacy DC 32 checks to douse the flames; Athletics to do the work yourself or Diplomacy to muster the ghostly soldiers. This reduces the hazard's actions by 1 and prevents it from using Burning Timbers. Banish the demons with up to two Arcana DC 35, Occultism DC 35, or Religion DC 35 checks; each success reduces the hazard's actions by 1, and two successes prevent it from using Demonic Abduction. When the hazard loses all 3 actions, Burning Timbers, and Demonic Abduction, it's disabled.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The haunt spends 1 action to fill the hall with burning timbers falling from above, and 2 actions to pluck up random victims and drop them to their deaths.
datos.reinicio: The hall falls quiet for 24 hours, after which it can trigger again.

hallowed-wheel.fuente: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God
hallowed-wheel.descripcion: An ornate wheel, divided into eight segments with a rune painted on each, is mounted on a pole and controlled by a lever that can be triggered manually or a sensor that detects creatures within 30 feet in front of it.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 31 (master) on the wheel to flip the switch returning it to a harmless carnival game, Thievery DC 26 (expert) to erase each rune, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract each rune.
datos.rutina:
(2 actions) On its initiative, the trap uses its first action to spin, then stops. Roll 1d8 to determine which segment is topmost when the wheel stops spinning. The wheel uses its second action to replicate the spell listed for that segment (5th level, DC 27, spell attack roll +17). This spell's target is centered on or otherwise includes the nearest creature in the spell's area. This increases the spell's range to 30 feet if necessary. Any spell cast by this trap is occult.

1 - Black Tentacles 20-foot burst Spell Attack vs. Target's Fortitude DC

2 - Blindness Fortitude DC 27

3 - Confusion Will DC 27

4 - Death Ward Range 30 feet

5 - Outcast's Curse Will DC 27 Range 30 feet

6 - Shadow Blast 30-foot line basic Reflex DC 27 or basic Will DC 27 5d8 force damage

7 - Noise Blast 10-foot burst Fortitude DC 27 2d10 sonic damage

8 - Gecko Grip Range 30 feet
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without any creature moving within range of its sensor.

horrible-r-pond.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-14: Twice in Steel
horrible-r-pond.descripcion: The illusion of a normal, if dirty, pond is broken by clammy hands reaching up from the depths. While they never break the surface, travelers feel compelled to reach for the grasping fingers and willingly walk to their doom.

datos.desactivar: Deception DC 32, Diplomacy DC 32 or Religion DC 32 (expert) to calm the spirits; two successes required, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 32) to dispel the magic.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The pond attempts to Grab all PCs in the water with a {+22} Athletics bonus. Any Grabbed or Restrained PCs take 4d12+26 void (unholy) damage (basic Fortitude DC 32 save). All PCs within 30 feet must then make a save against Call of the Depths.
datos.reinicio: When there are no living humanoids within 30 feet of the pond, the hands recede into the depths and the pond resets.

let-my-torments-be-yours.fuente: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies
let-my-torments-be-yours.descripcion: The skeleton suddenly appears to lurch forward, crying out in pain as a shaking voice begs for someone to take away the pain.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 32 (master) to carefully remove the Vile Remnant from the skeleton's ribcage without triggering the haunt or Religion DC 35 (expert) to exorcise the haunt

locking-alarm.descripcion: Any attempt to open the door without first tracing the symbol of Yhidothrus (an hourglass) on the door's face with a fingertip causes a glowing green ward to seal the door shut and raise an alarm.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 32 (expert) to bypass the magical triggers on the door, or Dispel Magic (5th rank, counteract DC 29) to counteract the alarm.
datos.reinicio: The locking alarm resets after 1 minute.

manor-wards.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
manor-wards.descripcion: Layers of fulus and strips of prayer-printed ribbons are plastered over the walls and entrances to the manor, demarcating a boundary around the mansion where no ghosts or spirits can pass.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 35 (master), Occultism DC 35 (master), or Thievery DC 35 (master) to compromise the magic to allow entry into the manor, Athletics DC 32 to force your way through the barrier and enter the manor (this doesn't allow other PCs to enter behind you, though!), or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 28) to counteract the wards
datos.reinicio: The wards reset automatically, continuing to prevent entry and damaging those who attempt to bypass them until they're disabled.

mask-of-aroden-s-guises.fuente: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God
mask-of-aroden-s-guises.descripcion: Ten masks adorn twelve stone statues.

datos.desactivar: Religion DC 29 (expert) or Occultism DC 29 or Thievery DC 31 (expert) to dismiss the magic on a single statue. Replacing the two missing masks (a mask made of or incorporating coins on the merchant statue and a mask made of any valuable fabric on the tailor statue) and succeeding at a Religion DC 27 check disarms the trap.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) An unmasked statue casts Phantasmal Killer (Will DC 27 and Fortitude DC 27) against a target in the room for each of the trap's actions, creating an image of the statue lunging forth. It doesn't affect the same creature more than once; if there are fewer targets than it has actions, the trap doesn't use its remaining actions. Unmasking an additional statue increases the hazard's actions by 1, and replacing a mask reduces its actions by 1.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets 1 minute after it has no target creatures

mocking-puppets.descripcion: The puppets and marionettes in this room suddenly turn to face intruders and come to clattering, unsettling life as the echoing sound of mocking laughter fills the air.

datos.desactivar: Performance DC 32 (master) to distract and entertain the haunted puppets and make them forget their anguish and despair, or Religion DC 35 (expert) to exorcise the haunt; four successes are required to disable it
datos.rutina: (1 action) The room's puppets and marionettes clatter to life and begin to swarm about the room, throwing rubble at living intruders, stabbing them in the ankles with sharp bits of broken metal, and slashing at them with lashes from long, thin marionette cords. At the same time, other puppets cackle, mock, and pantomime a chosen foe. The haunt uses its action to target one living creature in area C2; that creature must attempt a Will DC 29 save or become Slowed 1 for 1 round by the mockery (or Slowed 2 on a critical failure); this effect has the emotion and mental traits. At the same time, because the puppets constantly swarm about, they can use the Puppet Attack free action (see below) to attack targets during their turns.
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates if no living creatures are in area C2, then resets 1 minute later.

perilous-flash-flood.descripcion: Whether made up of water rushing through the streets that sweeps up dangerous debris along the way or a less natural substance bursting free of its container, this relentless flood batters everything in its path.

datos.desactivar: Three Athletics DC 35, Crafting DC 35, or Survival DC 35 checks to move or construct barricades strong enough to create a shelter from the flood. While this creates a safe place to stand, creatures outside of the barricaded area may still be in danger depending on the nature and the source of the flood.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The flood advances forward 60 feet, crashing into all creatures within its area. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude DC 30 save as the floodwaters pummel them and pull them downstream. The amount and type of damage dealt are based on the nature of the flood, and certain types of floods impose additional effects. The turbulent waters mean creatures within the area of the flood must attempt a Athletics DC 20 check to Swim in order to move, and those who do not succeed at a check to Swim each round may drown.

This caustic flood dissolves flesh as it moves, dealing 1d12 bludgeoning damage and 1d12+8 acid damage. Additionally, it deals 2d6 persistent damage to creatures who critically fail their Fortitude saves.

—

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is moved 10 feet along with the water.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is moved 20 feet along with the water.

punish-the-impertinent.descripcion: Three shadow tendrils emerge from the ground and seize trespassers.

datos.desactivar:
Arcana DC 32 or Occultism DC 32 (expert) to banish one of the three the shadow tendrils or Thievery DC 34 (master) twice to confound the bowl's magical sensors

Bypass A creature who places an offering worth at least 10 gp into the bowl doesn't trigger the trap and isn't targeted by the trap.
datos.rutina: (2 actions per shadow tendril) On its turn, each shadow tendril uses 1 action to make a lash Strike against a creature in the area, then uses 1 action to Constrict a creature it has Grabbed. The shadow tendrils don't apply the trap's multiple attack penalty.
datos.reinicio: The trap resets after 10 minutes.

sewer-pipe-trap.descripcion: Pressure-sensitive panels in the floor connects to a metal plate holding a number of sewer pipes shut in the ceiling.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 32 (expert) on the floor panels before the plate falls away

shadow-roil.descripcion: A cyclone of living shadows and planar magic surges around the area, attracted to living creatures.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 32 or Occultism DC 32 (expert) to weaken the tornado; three successes in any combination are required to disable the trap.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The cyclone uses 3 actions to move, traveling up to 30 feet with each action and dealing 2d12+13 slashing damage to each creature in its path (basic Reflex DC 33 save). A creature needs to attempt only one save during the cyclone's movement, even if the cyclone moves over its space more than once. On a critical failure, a creature is swept up into the cyclone, becoming Grabbed (). A creature grabbed by the cyclone moves along with the cyclone and takes 1d12+7 additional slashing damage at the beginning of its turn, and it must attempt the basic Reflex save against the cyclone on the cyclone's turn, no matter where the cyclone moves. A creature that successfully Escapes from the cyclone falls from a height of 1d20 × 5 feet.
datos.reinicio: The cyclone disperses after 1 minute and resets after 1 day.

shaken-loose.descripcion: The Granite Ox shakes off centuries of accumulated earth, flinging the PCs toward its hindquarters.

spear-jaw-trap.descripcion: Motion-sensitive fungus tendrils cause spears to shoot out of the floor and ceiling, almost like teeth.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 30 (expert) on the spear panels from any adjacent space, or Nature DC 32 (master) to slowly scrape away the motion-sensitive tendrils without triggering the trap
datos.reinicio: The trap resets in 1 round after a creature leaves its space.

steaming-flow.descripcion: The elemental-infused fountain spouts boiling water in a singular direction, carrying all non-aquatic creatures caught in it across the hallway and toward the perilous drop-off in the opposite tower!

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 25 (trained), Nature DC 25 (trained), or Survival DC 25 (trained) to divert the flow into weaker streams, or Athletics DC 27, Crafting DC 27 (trained), or Thievery DC 27 (trained) to break up the ground to weaken the flow; two successes (or one critical success) are needed to disable the hazard.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The hazard attempts an Athletics check with a +28 modifier to  all creatures in the water-filled areas in areas E5 and E6 toward the drop-off in area E7; the boiling spring gains a +4 circumstance bonus to its Fortitude DC against this effect. Any creature ending its turn in the flow also takes 2d12+12 fire damage with a basic Fortitude DC 29 save.

sudden-geysers.descripcion: The pooling seawater burbles and hisses.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 32 or Nature DC 32 (master) to dissipate the fire-aligned energies in the water, or Diplomacy DC 28 or Religion DC 28 to beseech Sangeh and convince her to momentarily tamp down her mythic power; two successes are required to disable the hazard
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The hazard uses each of its actions to create a Blistering Plume centered on a space chosen by the GM. Each successful check to disable the hazard removes one action from this routine.

trapped-lathe.descripcion: The powered lathe's springs have been critically overwound so that when jostled or triggered, the lathe unwinds violently, hurling blades, gears, and sharp shards of metal around the room.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 31 (expert) on the lathe releases the tension on its springs without unleashing its blades and gears.
datos.rutina: (4 actions) The lathe attempts four sharpened fragment attacks against creatures in the room, selecting a target randomly from all available targets in area A1. The trap does not take multiple attack penalties for any of its attacks. The trap loses 1 action each turn as its springs wind down, and becomes disabled when it has 0 actions.

tree-of-dreadful-dreams.descripcion: The statue of the willow tree animates, its branches lashing out to try to grab anyone in area B2.

datos.desactivar: Athletics DC 25 or Thievery DC 25 (trained) to force or lever open a single branch, disabling that branch and freeing any creature trapped within. Thievery DC 29 (expert) to disrupt the tree's magical animation, shut it down, and free all trapped creatures. Placing a dreamstone in the tree's trunk takes 2 Interact actions and causes the trap to shut down, freeing all trapped creatures. Placing the cursed dreamstone from area B4 in the trunk instead increases the tree's actions per turn to 4 and gives it a +2 item bonus to all saving throws and attack rolls.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The statue uses each action to attempt a branch Strike against a random creature in the room that it hasn't Grabbed. If there are no creatures for it to attack and it has at least one creature grabbed, it instead Constricts. The trap can have up to six creatures grabbed.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets if it has no creatures Grabbed and no creatures in the room to attack. If an uncursed dreamstone is placed in its trunk, the statue doesn't reactivate.

typhoon-koi-egg.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-11: The Godsrain and the Dragon
typhoon-koi-egg.descripcion: A raging storm covers the mountain lake as spring water levitates from the lake to fall back down in a driving spiral of steaming rain. In the depths of the storm, barely visible, is a tiny koi egg surrounded by three bands of water.

datos.desactivar: Arcana DC 30, Religion DC 30, Nature DC 30, or Occultism DC 30 to purify the magic corrupting the ascension ritual, or Diplomacy DC 33 or Performance DC 33 to soothe the spirit within the koi egg and give it the strength to fight off the corruption itself; four total successes are required to purify the ritual, each of the first three successes purifying one ring of water and the final one halting the ritual itself. If the cursed comb has not been removed from the ritual site, then succeeding on this final check merely halts the ritual; if the cursed comb has been removed from the ritual site, then succeeding on this final check completes the ascension ritual.
datos.rutina: (1 action) Torrential water descends from the sky, taking the shape of a dragon that smashes into one creature within 60 feet of the egg. The dragon always targets the creature that is closest to the egg, dealing 2d12+2 bludgeoning damage and 2d12 fire damage in a spray of boiling water (Fortitude DC 28 save). Creatures that fail the save are pushed 10 feet away. Creatures that have the earth trait, are carrying an item with the earth trait, or are otherwise strongly tied to elemental earth (such as an earth elemental sorcerer or kineticist) get the result one degree of success better than the outcome of their save, as the power of elemental earth overcomes water.
datos.reinicio: The turbulent koi egg can attempt to hatch again, restarting the ascension ritual, after 1000 years of Xalreonshin's care.

tyrant-s-orders.descripcion: Yagrekash appears to berate weak soldiers for not doing their part.

datos.desactivar: Deception DC 28 (expert) or Performance DC 28 (expert) to feign joining the fray, or Religion DC 30 (master) to ward Yagrekash away; three total successes in any combination are required to disable the haunt
datos.reinicio: The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area of Fort Whiteskull but resets immediately. Tyrant's orders resets 1 day after being disabled if the ancestor storm isn't put to rest.

unwelcoming-facade.fuente: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation
unwelcoming-facade.descripcion: An unsettling wave of malice and sinister energy ripples invisibly out from the manor, causing those who view the building to see a leering, evil face glaring at them from the structure's architecture.

datos.desactivar:
Occultism DC 32 or Religion DC 32 to exorcise the haunt, Society DC 35 to approach the manor in a proper way that defers to its occupant's symbolic standing in the community; displaying an official pass that legally grants permission to enter the building reduces both of these DCs by 5 (provided the PCs approach the front door and not from another direction).
Occultism DC 27 Religion DC 27 Society DC 30
datos.reinicio: The unwelcoming facade resets immediately if not disabled and can be triggered again the very next round.

wrath-of-the-destroyer.descripcion: These heavy doors, carved with an image of Dahak, echo with a hatred so powerful that it can kill anyone who comes nearby, manifesting a vision of Dahak's head emerging from the doors to strike at a foe.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 29 (expert) to disrupt the divine magic, Religion DC 29 (expert) to placate the wrathful energies, or Dispel Magic (5th rank; counteract DC 26).
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its initiative, the wrath of the destroyer targets the closest target in area C6 with Face of the Fatal Divine.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without any creature being in range.

xarwin-caul.descripcion: The Caul is a thin layer of transparent, moist webbing clinging to the manor's exterior surfaces. The stuff feels slippery and unnaturally cold to the touch, and it clings and stretches when a finger or other object used to touch the Caul is pulled away.

datos.desactivar: Occultism DC 32 (master) or Religion DC 34 (expert) to exorcise the caul
datos.reinicio: 1 week; putting Xarwin's ghost to rest permanently destroys the haunt.

zogototaru.descripcion: Narseigus's worm-calling enchantments have attained imperfect control over Zogototaru, compelling her to aid him. She follows his directions loosely and with little finesse.

datos.desactivar: Disable Arcana DC 28 or Occultism DC 28 (trained) to identify a loophole in mind-controlling magic, Diplomacy DC 30 to reason with Zogototaru, or Deception DC 31 or Performance DC 31 to speak as if the PC were Taargick
datos.rutina: (1 action) Zogototaru acts on Narseigus's most recent command, either Rescuing, Roaring, or Thrashing.

ballista-defense.descripcion: A ballista armed with a massive bolt fires on a creature approaching the Palace.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 36 (master) to sabotage the ballista by reaching through the firing slit from outside (this DC is reduced by 10 if the PCs are in the room with the ballista, Thievery DC 26), or Intimidation DC 33 to frighten off the Pitax Warden operating the ballista.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The ballista takes 1 action to fire a ballista bolt and 2 actions to reload. After ten rounds, the ballista is out of ammunition and can no longer function.
datos.reinicio: (1 day) If the PCs haven't reached 30 Liberation Points, additional ammunition for a ballista can be secured in a day, but if the PCs have reached 30 Liberation Points, a ballista that runs out of ammo cannot be reset.

befuddling-gas-trap.descripcion: Seven nozzles hidden within holes in the 15‑foot-high ceiling release a poison gas.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 33 (master) to disable the hidden mechanism on the north wall, immediately sucking the gas from the room, or Thievery DC 29 (expert) to adequately plug one of the seven nozzles. When all seven nozzles are plugged or destroyed, the trap is deactivated.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The gas intensifies. Each creature in the room must make a Fortitude DC 30.

—

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to the gas for 1 hour, though if the creature has already been stupefied by the trap, that condition remains for its normal duration.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature becomes Stupefied 1 for 24 hours. If the target is already stupefied, the condition value increases by 1 (to a maximum of stupefied 4) and the target takes 8d6 mental damage.

Critical Effect As failure, except the target takes double the mental damage.
datos.reinicio: After an hour, the trap deactivates; the gas disperses slowly, and the doors can be opened again. After 24 hours, the gas builds up and the trap can be triggered again.

breath-of-blood.descripcion: A churning pool of blood bubbles and seethes, periodically venting noxious vapors into the air.

datos.desactivar: Three Nature DC 33 or Occultism DC 33 checks to draw from the blood its magical nature, causing it to clot and become inert, a Religion DC 36 check to offer prayers to sever the sacred link to Kabriri, or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 29) to render the hazard inert for 10 minutes
datos.rutina: (2 actions) The bubbles furiously sputter and burst on the hazard's first action, filling the air with toxic vapor that inflicts 6d6 poison damage (basic Fortitude DC 30 save) to all creatures in area J3b. A creature that's holding its breath gains a +4 circumstance bonus to this save. On the hazard's second action, the bubbles Vent Toxins at a random target in area J3b.
datos.reinicio: The hazard settles back down 1 round after all creatures leave the room and can trigger again at the start of the next round.

bull-stampede.descripcion: Agitated aurochs trample through the streets.

datos.desactivar: Four Athletics DC 27, Intimidation DC 27, Nature DC 27 (expert), or Survival DC 27 (expert) checks to guide the herd, find it paths through Stockside, or keep it in line.
datos.rutina:
(1 action) The stampede advances, trampling everything in its path. Each creature attempting to control the stampede must attempt a Reflex DC 30 save or be caught up in the stampede, taking 2d12+15 bludgeoning damage; a creature who succeeded at a skill check to disable the hazard this round has a +1 circumstance bonus to the Reflex save.

—
Critical Success The creature takes no damage.
Success The creature takes half damage.
Failure The creature takes full damage.
Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and cannot attempt to disable the hazard next round, as they must spend it extricating themselves from the stampede.

caustic-dart-trap.descripcion: Three launching mechanisms built into the mudbrick walls expel darts containing acidic chemicals. All three launching mechanisms must be disabled or destroyed to deactivate the trap.

datos.desactivar: Thievery DC 32 (master) to sufficiently jam the tubes to make the trap unable to attack creatures in a single 5-foot square in the room, or Crafting DC 34 (master) to alter one of the three launching mechanisms.
datos.rutina: (3 actions) The trap uses each action for a caustic dart Strike. The trap loses 1 action for each launching mechanism that is broken or destroyed.
datos.reinicio: The trap deactivates and resets 1 minute after no creatures are in area C7

clockwork-poison-bomb.descripcion: A clockwork bomb releases gouts of poisonous smoke. The smoke issues forth from a single nozzle attached to two tanks of pressurized poison

datos.desactivar: Three {DC 31 Thievery} (expert) checks to Disable a Device to disable the latches that lock the nozzle in place, then one {DC 35 Thievery} (master) check to Disable a Device to turn off the nozzle; DCs decrease by 2 if Oggvurm is immobilized, paralyzed, unconscious, or dead
datos.rutina: (1 action) On its turn, the bomb spews forth a smoky gout of airborne Blackfinger Blight poison. The cloud fills a 20-foot radius, or a 10-foot radius if only one tank remains intact. If the bomb is already in the center of a blackfinger blight cloud, the radius of that cloud increases by 20 feet (or 10 feet, if only one tank remains intact) instead.
datos.reinicio: The trap issues smoke for 3 minutes before its tanks run dry. The tanks must be replaced before the bomb can be reactivated.

conference-z-s-victims-9-10.fuente: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-11: The Hidden Current
conference-z-s-victims-9-10.descripcion: The pain of over 300 souls crying out for recognition and revenge pierces through the room, as a spiritual whirlwind fills the space.

datos.desactivar: Medicine DC 33 or Society DC 33 to determine 287's first or surname through the journal text or Occultism DC 35 or Religion DC 35 to connect with the spiritual energy bound to the journal to find her name. Two successes are needed, one for each part of 287's name.
datos.rutina: (1 action) The haunt makes a howling wail Strike against all living creatures in area A13 as 1 action.
datos.reinicio: The haunt vanishes permanently if 287's name is revealed.
